function applyShimmerToText(obj, speed)
speed = speed or 0.8
local color = getThemeColor()
local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", obj)
grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, color),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color),
})
grad.Rotation = 45
grad.Offset = Vector2.new(0,0)
task.spawn(function()
local t = 0
while grad and grad.Parent do
t = t + 0.02
grad.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(t * speed) * 0.4, 0)
task.wait(0.04)
end
end)
return grad
end
function getDefaultButtonPosition(btnName)
local BTN_W, BTN_H = 78, 50
local GAP = 8
local orderMap = {
DropBR = 0, AutoLeft = 1, AutoBat = 2, AutoRight = 3,
TpReset = 4, Carry = 5, Lagger1 = 6, Lagger2 = 7
}
local order = orderMap[btnName] or 0
local row = _floor(order / 2)
local col = order % 2
return col * (BTN_W + GAP), row * (BTN_H + GAP + 10)
end
do
print("[IR] 1. inicio")
if _G.InstaResetLoaded then
print("[IR] ya cargado")
else
_G.InstaResetLoaded = true
local resetCooldown          = false
local resetThread            = nil
local currentResetChar       = nil
local resetSuccessful        = false
local stopResetSequence      = false
local cameraLocked           = false
local lockedCameraCFrame     = nil
local _lastInstaResetRequest = 0
print("[IR] 2. servicios OK, LP =", LP and LP.Name)
local function instaResetFast()
if resetCooldown then return end
resetCooldown     = true
resetSuccessful   = false
stopResetSequence = false
cameraLocked      = false
local character = LP.Character
if not character then resetCooldown = false return end
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not humanoid then resetCooldown = false return end
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam then
lockedCameraCFrame = cam.CFrame
cameraLocked       = true
cam.CFrame         = lockedCameraCFrame
end
currentResetChar = character
local isRespawning = false
resetThread = task.spawn(function()
local attempts          = 0
local maxAttempts       = 40
local originalHipHeight = humanoid.HipHeight
while character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
and not isRespawning and not stopResetSequence do
if LP.Character ~= character then
isRespawning = true
break
end
pcall(function()
humanoid.HipHeight  = 1e30
humanoid.AutoRotate = true
local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if rootPart then rootPart.CanCollide = false end
for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
part.CanCollide = false
end
end
end)
if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid
or humanoid.Health <= 0 or LP.Character ~= character then
resetSuccessful = true
break
end
attempts = attempts + 1
if attempts >= maxAttempts then break end
task.wait(0.05)
end
if not resetSuccessful then
if character and character.Parent and humanoid
and humanoid.Health > 0 and not isRespawning then
pcall(function() humanoid.Health = 0 end)
task.wait(0.1)
if not character.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
resetSuccessful = true
end
end
end
if not resetSuccessful and character and character.Parent and humanoid then
pcall(function()
humanoid.HipHeight = originalHipHeight
local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if rootPart then rootPart.CanCollide = true end
for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
part.CanCollide = true
end
end
end)
end
cameraLocked      = false
resetCooldown     = false
resetThread       = nil
currentResetChar  = nil
stopResetSequence = false
end)
end
local function instaReset()
local now = os.clock()
if now - _lastInstaResetRequest < 0.75 then return end
_lastInstaResetRequest = now
instaResetFast()
end
print("[IR] 3. función lista")
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
stopResetSequence = true
if resetThread then pcall(task.cancel, resetThread); resetThread = nil end
resetCooldown    = false
currentResetChar = nil
cameraLocked     = false
end)
task.spawn(function()
while true do
task.wait(0.016)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cameraLocked and lockedCameraCFrame and cam then
cam.CFrame = lockedCameraCFrame
end
end
end)
print("[IR] 4. loop cámara iniciado")
_G.InstaReset = { Trigger = instaReset }
end
end
SKIN_MEDUSA = {
{id = 11563251, name = "Medusa 1"},
}
SKIN_BAT = {
{id = 14052995337, name = "Epic Katana", soundId = "rbxassetid://111808555599832", c0 = CFrame.new()},
{id = 126653333198410, name = "Bloody Katana", soundId = "rbxassetid://111808555599832", c0 = CFrame.new()},
}
DowmSkins = { batId = nil, medusaId = nil }
do
local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
local SKIN_BAT_BY_ID = {}
for _, skin in ipairs(SKIN_BAT) do SKIN_BAT_BY_ID[tostring(skin.id)] = skin end
local soundConns = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function getBatSkinConfig(assetId)
return SKIN_BAT_BY_ID[tostring(tonumber(tostring(assetId):match("%d+")) or assetId)]
end
local function setBatSkinSound(tool, assetId)
if not tool then return end
local config = assetId and getBatSkinConfig(assetId) or nil
local desired = config and config.soundId or nil
tool:SetAttribute("DowmCurrentBatSkinId", desired and tostring(config.id) or nil)
for _, sound in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
if sound:IsA("Sound") and sound.Name == "Slash" then
local original = sound:GetAttribute("DowmOriginalSlashSound")
if desired then
if original == nil then sound:SetAttribute("DowmOriginalSlashSound", sound.SoundId) end
sound.SoundId = desired
elseif original ~= nil then
sound.SoundId = original
sound:SetAttribute("DowmOriginalSlashSound", nil)
end
end
end
if not soundConns[tool] then
soundConns[tool] = tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
if not object:IsA("Sound") or object.Name ~= "Slash" then return end
local activeId = tool:GetAttribute("DowmCurrentBatSkinId")
if activeId then task.defer(setBatSkinSound, tool, activeId) end
end)
end
end
local function loadAssetObjects(assetId)
assetId = tonumber(tostring(assetId):match("%d+"))
if not assetId then return nil end
local ok, res = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)) end)
if ok and type(res) == "table" and #res > 0 then return res end
ok, res = pcall(function() return InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId) end)
if ok and res then
if res:IsA("Model") then
local children = res:GetChildren()
if #children > 0 then return children end
end
return { res }
end
return nil
end
local function getCharModel()
return workspace:FindFirstChild(LP.Name) or LP.Character
end
local function findTool(name)
local model = getCharModel()
if model then
local t = model:FindFirstChild(name)
if t then return t end
end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
if bp then
local t = bp:FindFirstChild(name)
if t then return t end
end
return nil
end
local function clearGearVisual(tool)
if not tool then return end
pcall(function()
local folder = tool:FindFirstChild("DowmGearVisual")
if folder then folder:Destroy() end
local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
if handle then
for _, ch in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
if ch.Name == "DowmGearMesh" or (ch:IsA("SpecialMesh") and ch:GetAttribute("DowmSkin")) then
ch:Destroy()
end
end
local orig = tool:GetAttribute("DowmOrigHandleTrans")
if orig ~= nil then
handle.Transparency = orig
elseif handle.Transparency >= 0.99 then
handle.Transparency = 0
end
end
end)
end
local function applyAssetToTool(tool, assetId)
if not tool or not assetId then return false end
if tool:GetAttribute("DowmApplying") then return false end
tool:SetAttribute("DowmApplying", true)
assetId = tonumber(tostring(assetId):match("%d+")) or assetId
local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
if not handle then
tool:SetAttribute("DowmApplying", nil)
return false
end
local success = false
pcall(function()
clearGearVisual(tool)
if tool:GetAttribute("DowmOrigHandleTrans") == nil then
tool:SetAttribute("DowmOrigHandleTrans", handle.Transparency)
end
local objs = loadAssetObjects(assetId)
if not objs or #objs == 0 then return end
local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "DowmGearVisual"
folder.Parent = tool
local srcTool, srcHandle
for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
if o:IsA("Tool") then
srcTool = o
srcHandle = o:FindFirstChild("Handle") or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
break
end
local t = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool", true)
if t then
srcTool = t
srcHandle = t:FindFirstChild("Handle") or t:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
break
end
end
if not srcHandle then
for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
if o:IsA("BasePart") then srcHandle = o; break end
local p = o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
if p then srcHandle = p; break end
end
end
local skinConfig = tool.Name == "Bat" and getBatSkinConfig(assetId) or nil
local orientFix = skinConfig and skinConfig.c0 or CFrame.new()
local parts = {}
local root = srcTool or objs[1]
if root then
if root:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, root) end
if root:IsA("Accessory") then
local ah = root:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if ah then table.insert(parts, ah) end
end
for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, d) end
end
end
if #parts == 0 and srcHandle then table.insert(parts, srcHandle) end
local seen, unique = {}, {}
for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
if not seen[p] then seen[p] = true; table.insert(unique, p) end
end
parts = unique
if #parts > 0 then
handle.Transparency = 1
local pivot = srcHandle or parts[1]
for _, src in ipairs(parts) do
local okc, clone = pcall(function() return src:Clone() end)
if okc and clone then
clone.Name = "GV_" .. tostring(src.Name)
clone.Anchored = false
clone.CanCollide = false
clone.Massless = true
pcall(function()
clone.CanQuery = false
clone.CanTouch = false
end)
local rel = pivot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(src.CFrame)
clone.CFrame = handle.CFrame * orientFix * rel
clone.Parent = folder
local w = Instance.new("Weld")
w.Name = "DowmGearWeld"
w.Part0 = handle
w.Part1 = clone
w.C0 = orientFix * rel
w.C1 = CFrame.new()
w.Parent = clone
success = true
end
end
elseif srcHandle then
local mesh = srcHandle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
if mesh then
local m = mesh:Clone()
m.Name = "DowmGearMesh"
m:SetAttribute("DowmSkin", true)
m.Parent = handle
success = true
end
for _, d in ipairs(srcHandle:GetChildren()) do
if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
pcall(function() d:Clone().Parent = handle end)
end
end
pcall(function()
handle.Color = srcHandle.Color
handle.Material = srcHandle.Material
handle.Reflectance = srcHandle.Reflectance
end)
end
for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
end)
tool:SetAttribute("DowmApplying", nil)
if success and tool.Name == "Bat" then setBatSkinSound(tool, assetId) end
return success
end
function DowmSkins.apply(category, id)
local tool = (category == "medusa") and findTool("Medusa's Head") or findTool("Bat")
if not tool then return false end
local ok = false
if id == nil then
clearGearVisual(tool)
if category == "bat" then setBatSkinSound(tool, nil) end
ok = true
else
ok = applyAssetToTool(tool, id) == true
end
if ok then
if category == "medusa" then DowmSkins.medusaId = id else DowmSkins.batId = id end
pcall(function() saveAllSettings() end)
end
return ok
end
local restoring = false
function DowmSkins.applySaved()
if restoring then return end
if DowmSkins.batId == nil and DowmSkins.medusaId == nil then return end
restoring = true
task.spawn(function()
local deadline = os.clock() + 30
local batDone = (DowmSkins.batId == nil)
local medDone = (DowmSkins.medusaId == nil)
while os.clock() < deadline and not (batDone and medDone) do
if not batDone then
local t = findTool("Bat")
if t then batDone = applyAssetToTool(t, DowmSkins.batId) == true end
end
if not medDone then
local t = findTool("Medusa's Head")
if t then medDone = applyAssetToTool(t, DowmSkins.medusaId) == true end
end
task.wait(0.6)
end
restoring = false
end)
end
task.spawn(function()
task.wait(2.5)
DowmSkins.applySaved()
end)
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
task.wait(1.4)
DowmSkins.applySaved()
end)
end
DONW_HUB_FONT = nil
function loadDownHubFont()
-- fonte customizada removida: o menu usa a fonte normal (SourceSans)
if true then return end
local fontAssetGetter = getcustomasset or getsynasset
if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(fontAssetGetter) ~= "function" then return end
local fontPath, jsonPath = "Monter_Duels_Starborn.ttf", "Monter_Duels_Starborn.json"
local fontReady = false
if type(isfile) == "function" then pcall(function() fontReady = isfile(fontPath) end) end
if not fontReady then
local okDownload, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet("https://files.catbox.moe/pwgdui.ttf") end)
if not okDownload or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 1000 then return end
if not pcall(writefile, fontPath, data) then return end
end
local okAsset, fontAsset = pcall(fontAssetGetter, fontPath)
if not okAsset or not fontAsset then return end
local okJson = pcall(function()
writefile(jsonPath, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({name = "Starborn", faces = {{name = "Regular", weight = 400, style = "normal", assetId = fontAsset}}}))
end)
if not okJson then return end
local okJsonAsset, jsonAsset = pcall(fontAssetGetter, jsonPath)
if not okJsonAsset or not jsonAsset then return end
local okFont, customFont = pcall(function() return Font.new(jsonAsset) end)
if not okFont or not customFont then return end
DONW_HUB_FONT = customFont
end
function applyDownHubFont(root)
if not DONW_HUB_FONT or not root then return end
local function apply(obj)
if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
pcall(function() obj.FontFace = DONW_HUB_FONT end)
end
end
apply(root)
for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do apply(d) end
end

-- Falling Red Particles Background System (Passive, non-blocking)
local particlesHolder = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
particlesHolder.Name = "ParticlesHolder"
particlesHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
particlesHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
particlesHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
particlesHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
particlesHolder.ZIndex = 0
particlesHolder.Active = false
particlesHolder.Selectable = false
particlesHolder.ClipsDescendants = false

local particles = {}
local PARTICLE_COUNT = 0
local rnd = math.random
local sin = math.sin

local redTones = {
Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220),
Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180),
Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245),
Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150)
}

for i = 1, PARTICLE_COUNT do
local p = Instance.new("Frame", particlesHolder)
local sz = rnd(2, 5)
p.Size = UDim2.new(0, sz, 0, sz)
p.Position = UDim2.new(rnd() * 0.98, 0, rnd() * 0.98, 0)
p.BackgroundColor3 = redTones[rnd(1, #redTones)]
p.BackgroundTransparency = rnd(28, 68) / 100
p.BorderSizePixel = 0
p.ZIndex = 0
p.Active = false
p.Selectable = false
Instance.new("UICorner", p).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

table.insert(particles, {
frame = p,
x = rnd(),
y = rnd(),
speedY = rnd(22, 65) / 1000,
swayAmp = rnd(8, 20) / 1000,
swaySpeed = rnd(12, 26) / 10,
phase = rnd() * 6.28
})
end

local pConn
pConn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if not gui or not gui.Parent or not particlesHolder or not particlesHolder.Parent then
if pConn then pConn:Disconnect(); pConn = nil end
return
end
if main and not main.Visible then return end
local t = os.clock()
for _, pData in ipairs(particles) do
pData.y = pData.y + pData.speedY * dt
if pData.y > 1.05 then
pData.y = -0.05
pData.x = rnd()
end
local currentX = pData.x + sin(t * pData.swaySpeed + pData.phase) * pData.swayAmp
pData.frame.Position = UDim2.new(currentX, 0, pData.y, 0)
end
end)

gui.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
if not parent and pConn then
pConn:Disconnect()
pConn = nil
end
end)

    local launcherPing = launcherLabel("PingLabel", "PING  --ms", UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 94), UDim2.fromOffset(145, 28),
        Color3.fromRGB(225, 30, 40), Enum.Font.Code, 21, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)

    -- Live FPS/PING values for the launcher; use APIs available in Roblox clients.
    task.spawn(function()
        local frameCount = 0
        local last = os.clock()
        local fpsNow = 0
        local renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            frameCount += 1
        end)
        while openGui and openGui.Parent and launcherFPS and launcherFPS.Parent do
            task.wait(0.5)
            local now = os.clock()
            fpsNow = math.floor(frameCount / math.max(now - last, 0.001) + 0.5)
            frameCount = 0
            last = now
            local pingMs = 0
            local gotPing = pcall(function()
                pingMs = game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
            end)
            if not gotPing or not pingMs or pingMs <= 0 then
                pcall(function() pingMs = LP:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 end)
            end
            if launcherFPS and launcherFPS.Parent then launcherFPS.Text = "FPS  " .. tostring(fpsNow) end
            if launcherPing and launcherPing.Parent then launcherPing.Text = "PING  " .. tostring(math.floor((pingMs or 0) + 0.5)) .. "ms" end
        end
        if renderConn then renderConn:Disconnect() end
    end)

    local function forceOpenHub()
        if not main then return end
        pcall(function()
            if gui then
                gui.Enabled = true
                if not gui.Parent then
                    local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 3)
                    local ok = pcall(function() gui.Parent = pg end)
                    if not ok or not gui.Parent then
                        pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(gui) end end)
                        pcall(function() gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        main.Visible = true
        main.Active = true
        -- keep current position if already placed; only reset if off-screen
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
        local ox = main.Position.X.Offset
        local oy = main.Position.Y.Offset
        if ox < -50 or oy < -50 or ox > vp.X or oy > vp.Y then
            main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
        end
        mainOriginalPos = main.Position
        if miniBtn then miniBtn.Visible = true end
        -- soft open animation
        pcall(function()
            main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
            TS:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
            }):Play()
        end)
    end

    local function forceCloseHub()
        if main then
            pcall(function()
                TS:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
                }):Play()
            end)
            task.delay(0.12, function()
                if main then main.Visible = false; main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28 end
            end)
        end
        if miniBtn then miniBtn.Visible = true end
    end

    _G.DonwToggleHub = function()
        if main and main.Visible then
            forceCloseHub()
        else
            forceOpenHub()
        end
    end
    showGui = forceOpenHub
    hideGui = forceCloseHub

    -- Launcher: opens only on a tap; drag with touch or mouse to reposition.
    local launcherPressLock = false
    local launcherDragging = false
    local launcherMoved = false
    local launcherInput = nil
    local launcherDragStart = nil
    local launcherStartPos = nil
    local launcherJustDragged = false
    local launcherDragThreshold = 8

    miniBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
        if launcherInput then return end
        launcherInput = input
        launcherDragging = true
        launcherMoved = false
        launcherDragStart = input.Position
        launcherStartPos = miniBtn.Position
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not launcherDragging or not launcherInput then return end
        local isTouchMove = launcherInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == launcherInput
        local isMouseMove = launcherInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        if not isTouchMove and not isMouseMove then return end
        local delta = input.Position - launcherDragStart
        if delta.Magnitude >= launcherDragThreshold then launcherMoved = true end
        if launcherMoved then
            miniBtn.Position = UDim2.new(
                launcherStartPos.X.Scale, launcherStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                launcherStartPos.Y.Scale, launcherStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not launcherDragging or not launcherInput then return end
        local matching = input == launcherInput
            or (launcherInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
        if not matching then return end
        if launcherMoved then
            launcherJustDragged = true
            savedLauncherPos = {
                XScale = miniBtn.Position.X.Scale, XOffset = miniBtn.Position.X.Offset,
                YScale = miniBtn.Position.Y.Scale, YOffset = miniBtn.Position.Y.Offset,
            }
            pcall(saveAllSettings, true)
        end
        launcherDragging = false
        launcherInput = nil
        launcherDragStart = nil
        launcherStartPos = nil
        if launcherMoved then
            task.delay(0.2, function() launcherJustDragged = false end)
        end
    end)

    local function openFromLauncher()
        if launcherJustDragged or launcherDragging or launcherPressLock then return end
        launcherPressLock = true
        forceOpenHub()
        task.delay(0.35, function() launcherPressLock = false end)
    end
    -- Both the plus and the rest of the launcher open the panel.
    plusBox.Activated:Connect(openFromLauncher)
    miniBtn.Activated:Connect(openFromLauncher)
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

end)

local function colorTabIcon(root, color)
if not root then return end
for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("Frame") and obj.Name == "IconInk" then
obj.BackgroundColor3 = color
end
if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
obj.Color = color
end
end
end

local function drawTabIcon(parent, name, color, z)
local size = 18
local root = Instance.new("Frame")
root.Name = "SectionIcon"
root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
root.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -size / 2)
root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
root.ZIndex = z
root.Parent = parent
local function round(obj, r)
local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 2)
c.Parent = obj
end
local function line(x1, y1, x2, y2, thickness)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
local ink = Instance.new("Frame")
ink.Name = "IconInk"
ink.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
ink.Position = UDim2.fromScale((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
ink.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * size, thickness or 1.7)
ink.BackgroundColor3 = color
ink.BorderSizePixel = 0
ink.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
ink.ZIndex = z
ink.Parent = root
round(ink, 2)
end
local function box(x, y, w, h, radius, solid)
local object = Instance.new("Frame")
object.Name = "IconInk"
object.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
object.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
object.BackgroundColor3 = color
object.BackgroundTransparency = solid and 0 or 1
object.BorderSizePixel = 0
object.ZIndex = z
object.Parent = root
round(object, radius or 2)
if not solid then
local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
st.Color = color
st.Thickness = 1.35
st.Transparency = 0
st.Parent = object
end
return object
end

local pageCounters = {}
local function getNextOrder(page)
if not pageCounters[page] then pageCounters[page] = 0 end
pageCounters[page] = pageCounters[page] + 1
return pageCounters[page]
end

pill.ZIndex = 8
Instance.new("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", pill)
stroke.Color = ROW_BORDER
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Transparency = 0.3
stroke.Name = "PillStroke"
local dot = Instance.new("Frame", pill)
dot.Name = "Knob"

dot.ZIndex = 9
Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local function animPill(pill, dot, on)
local stroke = pill:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local info = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
TS:Create(dot, info, {
Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8),
BackgroundColor3 = on and getThemeColor() or Color3.fromRGB(100, 30, 38),
}):Play()
TS:Create(pill, info, {
BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(88, 14, 20) or Color3.fromRGB(32, 18, 20),
}):Play()
if stroke then
TS:Create(stroke, info, {
Color = on and getThemeColor() or ROW_BORDER,
Transparency = on and 0.15 or 0.3,
}):Play()
end
end
local function mkSlider(row, minV, maxV, default, cb)
local W = 44
local track = Instance.new("Frame", row)
track.Size = UDim2.new(0, W, 0, 4)
track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(W + 40), 0.5, -2)
track.BackgroundColor3 = INP
track.BackgroundTransparency = 0
track.BorderSizePixel = 0
track.ZIndex = 8
Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local fill = Instance.new("Frame", track)
fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = getThemeColor()
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.ZIndex = 9
Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local knob = Instance.new("Frame", track)
knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 13)
knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
knob.ZIndex = 11
Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local kStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", knob)
kStroke.Color = getThemeColor()
kStroke.Thickness = 2
local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
valLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 20)
valLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, -10)
valLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
valLabel.Text = tostring(default)
valLabel.TextColor3 = getThemeColor()
valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
valLabel.TextSize = 11
valLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
valLabel.ZIndex = 9
local hit = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
hit.Size = UDim2.new(0, W + 16, 0, 26)
hit.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(W + 48), 0.5, -13)
hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hit.Text = ""
hit.AutoButtonColor = false
hit.ZIndex = 12
local current = default
local function render(a)
a = _clamp(a, 0, 1)
fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = getThemeColor()
kStroke.Color = getThemeColor()
end
local function applyFromX(px)
local left = track.AbsolutePosition.X
local width = track.AbsoluteSize.X
if width <= 0 then width = W end
if left <= 0 then return end
local a = (px - left) / width
a = _clamp(a, 0, 1)
local v = _floor(minV + (maxV - minV) * a + 0.5)
current = v
valLabel.Text = tostring(v)
render(a)
if cb then pcall(cb, v) end
end
local dragging = false
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true
_isDraggingButton = true
applyFromX(i.Position.X)
end
end)
hit.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = false
_isDraggingButton = false
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
if not dragging then return end
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
applyFromX(i.Position.X)
end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if not dragging then return end
if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = false
_isDraggingButton = false
end
end)
local function setValue(v)
v = _clamp(tonumber(v) or minV, minV, maxV)
current = v
valLabel.Text = tostring(v)
render((v - minV) / (maxV - minV))
end
setValue(default)
return setValue
end
local function mkToggle(page, txt, cb)
local row = mkRow(page, 38)
mkLabel(row, txt)
local pill, dot = mkPill(row, 48)
local on = false
local function sv(s) on = s; animPill(pill, dot, s) end
local clk = Instance.new("TextButton", pill)
clk.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
clk.BackgroundTransparency = 1
clk.Text = ""
clk.AutoButtonColor = false
clk.ZIndex = 10
clk.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
on = not on
sv(on)
local ok, err = pcall(cb, on)
if not ok then warn("[dowm] toggle '" .. tostring(txt) .. "': " .. tostring(err)) end
end)
return sv
end

local function mkKeyButton(parent, kbEntry)
local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 22)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.5, -11)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(112, 18, 24)
btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local function getLabel() return (kbEntry.gp and kbEntry.gp.Name) or (kbEntry.kb and kbEntry.kb.Name) or "None" end
btn.Text = getLabel()
btn.TextColor3 = getThemeColor()
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btn.TextSize = 9
btn.ZIndex = 8
btn.AutoButtonColor = false
Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
local bs = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
bs.Color = ROW_BORDER
bs.Thickness = 0
local li = false; local lc; local pv = btn.Text; local listenStart = 0
btn.Activated:Connect(function()
if li then li = false; _anyKeyListening = false; if lc then lc:Disconnect(); lc = nil end; btn.Text = pv; btn.TextColor3 = getThemeColor(); return end
pv = btn.Text; li = true; _anyKeyListening = true; listenStart = _tick(); btn.Text = "..."; btn.TextColor3 = getThemeColor()
lc = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
if not li then return end
if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then li = false; _anyKeyListening = false; if lc then lc:Disconnect(); lc = nil end; btn.Text = pv; btn.TextColor3 = getThemeColor(); return end
local isGp = isGamepadInput(inp)
if isGp and _tick()-listenStart < 0.15 then return end
if not isBindableInput(inp) then return end
btn.Text = inp.KeyCode.Name; pv = inp.KeyCode.Name; btn.TextColor3 = getThemeColor()
li = false; _anyKeyListening = false; if lc then lc:Disconnect(); lc = nil end
if isGp then kbEntry.gp = inp.KeyCode; kbEntry.kb = nil else kbEntry.kb = inp.KeyCode; kbEntry.gp = nil end
end)
end)
table.insert(keyButtonRefs, {btn = btn, entry = kbEntry})
return btn
end

-- Ping Lagger na aba Ping Lagger.
do
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local CONFIG_FILE = "BloodHounds_PingLagger_Config.json"
local DEFAULT_CFG = {
    power         = 100000,
    interval      = 0.125,
    keybindKb     = "F",
    keybindGp     = "ButtonR2",
    autoBrainrot  = true,
}
local cfg = {
    power         = DEFAULT_CFG.power,
    interval      = DEFAULT_CFG.interval,
    keybindKb     = DEFAULT_CFG.keybindKb,
    keybindGp     = DEFAULT_CFG.keybindGp,
    autoBrainrot  = DEFAULT_CFG.autoBrainrot,
}

local function resolveKb(name)
    if not name or name == "" or name == "None" then return nil end
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[name] end)
    return (ok and val) or nil
end

local function saveConfig()
    local ok, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(cfg) end)
    if ok and encoded and writefile then
        pcall(writefile, CONFIG_FILE, encoded)
    end
end

local function loadConfig()
    if not (isfile and readfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE)) then return end
    local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE)) end)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    cfg.power        = tonumber(data.power) or DEFAULT_CFG.power
    cfg.interval     = tonumber(data.interval) or DEFAULT_CFG.interval
    cfg.keybindKb    = type(data.keybindKb) == "string" and data.keybindKb or DEFAULT_CFG.keybindKb
    cfg.keybindGp    = type(data.keybindGp) == "string" and data.keybindGp or DEFAULT_CFG.keybindGp
    if type(data.autoBrainrot) == "boolean" then cfg.autoBrainrot = data.autoBrainrot end
end
loadConfig()

local active            = false
local listeningFor      = nil
local remote            = nil
local brainrotMode      = false
local lastBrainrotState = false
local manualOverride    = false
local pingLoopId        = 0

local function isGamepadKey(kc)
    if not kc then return false end
    local n = kc.Name
    return n:sub(1,6)=="Button" or n:sub(1,10)=="Thumbstick"
        or n:sub(1,4)=="DPad" or n=="ButtonSelect" or n=="ButtonStart"
end

local BLACKLISTED = {
    [Enum.KeyCode.Escape]      = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.Unknown]     = true,
}

local function findRemote()
    local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
    if not rrs then return nil end
    local found
    for _, name in ipairs({"SetPlayerBlockList","UpdatePlayerBlockList","SetBlockList","UpdateBlockList"}) do
        local r = rrs:FindFirstChild(name)
        if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then found = r break end
    end
    if not found then
        for _, c in ipairs(rrs:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("RemoteEvent") and c.Name:find("Block") then found = c break end
        end
    end
    return found
end

remote = findRemote()

local function buildPayload(power)
    local safePower = tonumber(power) or DEFAULT_CFG.power
    if safePower < 1 then safePower = 1 end
    local main = {}
    local nested = {{}}
    local current = nested[1]
    for _ = 1, 186 do
        local n = {}
        table.insert(current, n)
        current = n
    end
    local maxRep = math.min(math.floor(safePower / 188), 10000)
    if maxRep < 1 then maxRep = 1 end
    for _ = 1, maxRep do
        table.insert(main, nested)
    end
    return main
end

local function runPingLoop(myId)
    local delay = cfg.interval
    while active and remote and pingLoopId == myId do
        local payload = buildPayload(cfg.power)
        local ok = pcall(function() remote:FireServer(payload) end)
        if not ok then
            delay = math.min(delay * 1.5, 0.5)
        else
            delay = math.max(delay * 0.995, 0.05)
        end
        task.wait(delay)
    end
end

local function flipLag(state, isManual)
    active = state and true or false
    if isManual then
        if brainrotMode then
            manualOverride = not state
        else
            manualOverride = false
        end
    end
    if active then
        if not remote then
            remote = findRemote()
            if not remote then
                active = false
            end
        end
    end
    pingLoopId = pingLoopId + 1
    if active then
        task.spawn(runPingLoop, pingLoopId)
    end
    PingLagger.active = active
    if PingLagger.setToggleVisual then PingLagger.setToggleVisual(active) end
end

local kbBindBtn, gpBindBtn

local function updateKbLabels()
    if kbBindBtn then
        if listeningFor == "kb" then
            kbBindBtn.Text = "Press a key..."
            kbBindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,200,100)
        else
            kbBindBtn.Text = cfg.keybindKb ~= "" and cfg.keybindKb or "None"
            kbBindBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
        end
    end
    if gpBindBtn then
        if listeningFor == "gp" then
            gpBindBtn.Text = "Press a button..."
            gpBindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,200,100)
        else
            gpBindBtn.Text = cfg.keybindGp ~= "" and cfg.keybindGp or "None"
            gpBindBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
        end
    end
end

local function saveAll()
    saveConfig()
    pcall(function() if not _isLoading and not _isResetting then saveAllSettings() end end)
end

local function resetSettings()
    cfg.power        = DEFAULT_CFG.power
    cfg.interval     = DEFAULT_CFG.interval
    cfg.keybindKb    = DEFAULT_CFG.keybindKb
    cfg.keybindGp    = DEFAULT_CFG.keybindGp
    cfg.autoBrainrot = DEFAULT_CFG.autoBrainrot
    listeningFor = nil
    _anyKeyListening = false
    if PingLagger.refresh then PingLagger.refresh() end
    saveConfig()
end

PingLagger = PingLagger or {}
PingLagger.defaults = {
    power = DEFAULT_CFG.power,
    interval = DEFAULT_CFG.interval,
    autoBrainrot = DEFAULT_CFG.autoBrainrot,
}
PingLagger.cfg = cfg
PingLagger.active = active
PingLagger.set = flipLag
PingLagger.refresh = function()
    if PingLagger.setToggleVisual then PingLagger.setToggleVisual(active) end
    if PingLagger.setAutoVisual then PingLagger.setAutoVisual(cfg.autoBrainrot) end
    if PingLagger.powerBox then PingLagger.powerBox.Text = tostring(cfg.power) end
    if PingLagger.intervalBox then PingLagger.intervalBox.Text = tostring(cfg.interval) end
    updateKbLabels()
end
PingLagger.resetDefaults = function()
    flipLag(false)
    resetSettings()
end

local pingPage = contentPages["Ping"]
mkSect(pingPage, "Ping Lagger")
PingLagger.setToggleVisual = mkToggle(pingPage, "Ping Lagger", function(on)

    saveAll()
end)
PingLagger.setAutoVisual(cfg.autoBrainrot)

do

do

    gpBindBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    gpBindBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    gpBindBtn.Text = cfg.keybindGp
    gpBindBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
    gpBindBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    gpBindBtn.TextSize = 11
    gpBindBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    gpBindBtn.ZIndex = 8
    Instance.new("UICorner", gpBindBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    gpBindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if listeningFor == "gp" then
            listeningFor = nil
            _anyKeyListening = false
        else
            listeningFor = "gp"
            _anyKeyListening = true
        end
        updateKbLabels()
    end)
end

do
    local row = mkRow(pingPage, 34)
    row:SetAttribute("L", "Reset Defaults")

updateKbLabels()

-- AUTO BRAINROT (igual Cursed/Ping Lagger: WalkSpeed < 25)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    do return end
    if not cfg.autoBrainrot then
        if brainrotMode then
            brainrotMode = false
            lastBrainrotState = false
        end
        return
    end
    if manualOverride then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local hasBrainrot = hum.WalkSpeed < 25
    if hasBrainrot and not lastBrainrotState then
        brainrotMode = true
        lastBrainrotState = true
        manualOverride = false
        if not active then flipLag(true, false) end
    elseif not hasBrainrot and lastBrainrotState then
        brainrotMode = false
        lastBrainrotState = false
        manualOverride = false
        if active then flipLag(false, false) end
    end
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    local kc = input.KeyCode
    if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
    local isGp = isGamepadKey(kc)
    local isKb = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
    if listeningFor then
        if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
            listeningFor = nil
            _anyKeyListening = false
            updateKbLabels()
            return
        end
        if listeningFor == "kb" and isKb and not BLACKLISTED[kc] then
            cfg.keybindKb = kc.Name
            listeningFor = nil
            _anyKeyListening = false
            updateKbLabels()
            saveAll()
            return
        end
        if listeningFor == "gp" and isGp then
            cfg.keybindGp = kc.Name
            listeningFor = nil
            _anyKeyListening = false
            updateKbLabels()
            saveAll()
            return
        end
        return
    end
    do return end
    local kbEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindKb)
    local gpEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindGp)
    if (kbEnum and kc == kbEnum and isKb) or (gpEnum and kc == gpEnum and isGp) then
        flipLag(not active, true)
    end
end)
end




local cursorRgbGui = nil
local cursorRgbConnection = nil
function setCursorRgbEnabled(enabled)
    cursorRgbEnabled = enabled and true or false
    if enabled then
        if cursorRgbGui and cursorRgbGui.Parent then return end
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not player then return end
        local playerGui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local oldCursor = playerGui:FindFirstChild("BloodHoundsCursorRGB")
        if oldCursor then oldCursor:Destroy() end

        cursorRgbGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        cursorRgbGui.Name = "BloodHoundsCursorRGB"
        cursorRgbGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        cursorRgbGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        cursorRgbGui.DisplayOrder = 100000
        cursorRgbGui.Parent = playerGui

        local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
        ring.Name = "RgbCursorRing"
        ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34)
        ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ring.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ring.Parent = cursorRgbGui

        local dots = {}
        local dotCount = 36
        local radius = 11.5
        for i = 1, dotCount do
            local angle = ((i - 1) / dotCount) * math.pi * 2
            local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
            dot.Name = "RgbDot"
            dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(angle) * radius, 0.5, math.sin(angle) * radius)
            dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
            dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
            dot.Parent = ring
            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            corner.Parent = dot
            dots[i] = dot
        end

        local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
        cursorRgbConnection = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local hue = (os.clock() * 0.22) % 1
            for i, dot in ipairs(dots) do
                dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((hue + (i - 1) / dotCount) % 1, 1, 1)
            end
        end)
        _G.BloodHoundsCursorRGBConnection = cursorRgbConnection
    else
        if cursorRgbConnection then
            cursorRgbConnection:Disconnect()
            cursorRgbConnection = nil
        end
        if _G.BloodHoundsCursorRGBConnection then
            _G.BloodHoundsCursorRGBConnection = nil
        end
        if cursorRgbGui then
            cursorRgbGui:Destroy()
            cursorRgbGui = nil
        end
    end
end

		top.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
			if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true; dstart = inp.Position; pstart = frame.Position
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
			if not dragging then return end
			if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				local d = inp.Position - dstart
				frame.Position = UDim2.new(pstart.X.Scale, pstart.X.Offset + d.X, pstart.Y.Scale, pstart.Y.Offset + d.Y)
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
			if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)

local SHOW_RADAR = true
local DETECCAO_UNICA = false -- false = Detectando continuamente (igual ao print, toggle desligado)
local UI_SCALE = 1.0
local ZOOM = 1.0
local TEXTURA_ATUAL = "Original"
local SAVED_POSITION = {xs = 0.5, xo = -185, ys = 0.5, yo = -260}

-- ================================

-- ============ SALVAR AUTOMÁTICO ============
-- Salva sozinho em RadarExeConfig.json toda vez que você muda algo na
-- engrenagem (textura, detecção, visibilidade, tamanho, zoom) e carrega
-- tudo de volta quando você executa o script de novo. Se o executor não
-- tiver writefile/readfile, ele só não salva (não dá erro).
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local CONFIG_FILE = "RadarExeConfig.json"
local function saveConfig()
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then
            writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({
                textura = TEXTURA_ATUAL,
                deteccaoUnica = DETECCAO_UNICA,
                mostrarRadar = SHOW_RADAR,
                mostrarNomes = SHOW_NAMES,
                mostrarRaio = SHOW_RADIUS_CIRCLE,
                uiScale = UI_SCALE,
                zoom = ZOOM,
                posXs = SAVED_POSITION.xs,
                posXo = SAVED_POSITION.xo,
                posYs = SAVED_POSITION.ys,
                posYo = SAVED_POSITION.yo,
            }))
        end
    end)
end
local function loadConfig()
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and readfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then
            local d = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE))
            if type(d) == "table" then
                if type(d.textura) == "string" then TEXTURA_ATUAL = d.textura end  -- applyTexture valida depois
                if d.deteccaoUnica ~= nil then DETECCAO_UNICA = d.deteccaoUnica end
                if d.mostrarRadar ~= nil then SHOW_RADAR = d.mostrarRadar end
                if d.mostrarNomes ~= nil then SHOW_NAMES = d.mostrarNomes end
                if d.mostrarRaio ~= nil then SHOW_RADIUS_CIRCLE = d.mostrarRaio end
                if type(d.uiScale) == "number" then UI_SCALE = math.clamp(d.uiScale, 0.5, 1.5) end
                if type(d.zoom) == "number" then ZOOM = math.clamp(d.zoom, 0.6, 2.0) end
                if type(d.posXs) == "number" then SAVED_POSITION.xs = d.posXs end
                if type(d.posXo) == "number" then SAVED_POSITION.xo = d.posXo end
                if type(d.posYs) == "number" then SAVED_POSITION.ys = d.posYs end
                if type(d.posYo) == "number" then SAVED_POSITION.yo = d.posYo end
            end
        end
    end)
end
-- A textura salva é aplicada depois, quando TEXTURAS/applyTexture existirem.
loadConfig()

local function corner(parent, r)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8)
    c.Parent = parent
    return c
end
local function stroke(parent, color, thick, transp)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = color
    s.Thickness = thick or 1
    s.Transparency = transp or 0
    s.Parent = parent
    return s
end

-- Texturas do mapa (só mudam o fundo/grade do radar, não o jogo)
local TEXTURAS = {
    ["Original"] = {bg = Color3.fromRGB(6, 10, 14), grid = Color3.fromRGB(30, 45, 50), preview = Color3.fromRGB(10, 16, 22)},
    ["Verde Militar"] = {bg = Color3.fromRGB(10, 22, 12), grid = Color3.fromRGB(38, 68, 42), preview = Color3.fromRGB(18, 46, 22)},
    ["Roxo Neon"] = {bg = Color3.fromRGB(16, 10, 26), grid = Color3.fromRGB(62, 40, 92), preview = Color3.fromRGB(42, 18, 68)},
    ["Vermelho Tático"] = {bg = Color3.fromRGB(26, 10, 10), grid = Color3.fromRGB(72, 36, 36), preview = Color3.fromRGB(58, 16, 16)},
    ["Preto Puro"] = {bg = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), grid = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28), preview = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)},
}
local function applyTexture(nome)
    local t = TEXTURAS[nome]
    if not t then return end
    TEXTURA_ATUAL = nome
    Radar.BackgroundColor3 = t.bg
    for _, line in ipairs(gridLines) do
        line.BackgroundColor3 = t.grid
    end
end
-- Aplica a textura salva (se tinha uma salva, já abre com ela)
pcall(function() applyTexture(TEXTURA_ATUAL) end)

local function toggleRow(text, default, callback)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")

    row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, sy)
    row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 36, 48)

    corner(row, 10)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    lbl.TextSize = 15
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 228, 233)
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = row
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 26)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0.5, -13)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = default and Color3.fromRGB(45, 212, 191) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 80)
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.Parent = row
    corner(btn, 13)
    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
    knob.Position = default and UDim2.new(1, -23, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -10)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = btn
    corner(knob, 10)
    local on = default
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        on = not on
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(45, 212, 191) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 80)
        knob.Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -23, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -10)
        callback(on)
    end)
    sy = sy + 52
    return btn
end

-- TEXTURA DO MAPA
sectionTitle("TEXTURA DO MAPA")
local textureBtns = {}
local texOrder = {"Original", "Verde Militar", "Roxo Neon", "Vermelho Tático", "Preto Puro"}
local texY = sy
for idx, nome in ipairs(texOrder) do
    local col = (idx - 1) % 2
    local rowIdx = math.floor((idx - 1) / 2)
    local x = 10 + col * 172
    local y = texY + rowIdx * 64
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 162, 0, 56)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 36, 48)
    b.Text = ""
    b.Parent = Scroll
    corner(b, 10)
    local st = stroke(b, nome == TEXTURA_ATUAL and Color3.fromRGB(45, 212, 191) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 80), nome == TEXTURA_ATUAL and 2 or 1, 0)
    local prev = Instance.new("Frame")
    prev.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 22)
    prev.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6)
    prev.BackgroundColor3 = TEXTURAS[nome].preview
    prev.BorderSizePixel = 0
    prev.Parent = b
    corner(prev, 6)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = nome
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    lbl.TextSize = 14
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 235)
    lbl.Parent = b
    textureBtns[nome] = {btn = b, stroke = st}
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        applyTexture(nome)
        saveConfig()
        for n, t in pairs(textureBtns) do
            local sel = (n == nome)
            t.stroke.Color = sel and Color3.fromRGB(45, 212, 191) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 80)
            t.stroke.Thickness = sel and 2 or 1
        end
    end)
end
sy = texY + math.ceil(#texOrder / 2) * 64 + 10

-- ============ DETECTAR BASES E JOGADORES ============
local spawnPos = {}
local function recordSpawn(plr)
    -- Sempre atualiza: no Duel você renasce na SUA base a cada round/morte,
    -- então a posição do renascimento É a base. Antes só gravava a 1ª vez,
    -- e se o script fosse executado com você na base do inimigo, gravava
    -- a base dele como se fosse a sua.
    local char = plr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then spawnPos[plr] = hrp.Position end
end
local function getHRP(plr)
    local char = plr.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
-- CORREÇÃO DO BUG DO PRINT: antes findBasePos devolvia o PRIMEIRO modelo
-- que batia pra qualquer jogador, então as 2 bases ganhavam a MESMA posição
-- e a caixa INIMIGA cobria a SUA BASE. Agora ele coleta TODOS os candidatos,
-- escolhe o mais perto do spawn daquele jogador, e nunca devolve a mesma
-- posição para os 2 jogadores.
local function findBaseCandidates(plr)
    local list = {}
    local ref = spawnPos[plr] or (getHRP(plr) and getHRP(plr).Position)
    local function add(pos, priority)
        if not pos then return end
        table.insert(list, {pos = pos, priority = priority})
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") then
            local owner = obj:FindFirstChild("Owner")
            if owner and owner:IsA("ObjectValue") and owner.Value == plr then
                add(obj:GetPivot().Position, 1)
            elseif owner and owner:IsA("StringValue") and (owner.Value == plr.Name or owner.Value == plr.DisplayName) then
                add(obj:GetPivot().Position, 1)
            elseif obj.Name:find(plr.Name) and (obj.Name:lower():find("base") or obj.Name:lower():find("plot")) then
                add(obj:GetPivot().Position, 2)
            elseif (obj.Name:lower():find("base") or obj.Name:lower():find("plot")) and obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
                -- base genérica (sem dono): só entra como último recurso
                add(obj:GetPivot().Position, 3)
            end
        end
        if obj:IsA("SpawnLocation") and obj.Name:find(plr.Name) then
            add(obj.Position, 1)
        end
    end
    -- Ordena: prioridade do dono primeiro, depois o mais perto do spawn
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        if a.priority ~= b.priority then return a.priority < b.priority end
        if ref then
            return (a.pos - ref).Magnitude < (b.pos - ref).Magnitude
        end
        return false
    end)
    return list
end

local function findBasePos(plr, excludePos)
    local cands = findBaseCandidates(plr)
    for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
        -- nunca devolve a posição já usada pela outra base
        if not excludePos or (c.pos - excludePos).Magnitude > 60 then
            return c.pos
        end
    end
    if spawnPos[plr] then
        if not excludePos or (spawnPos[plr] - excludePos).Magnitude > 60 then
            return spawnPos[plr]
        end
    end
    local hrp = getHRP(plr)
    if hrp then
        if not excludePos or (hrp.Position - excludePos).Magnitude > 60 then
            return hrp.Position
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Lista TODAS as bases da arena (no Duel são só 2). Deduplica posições
-- próximas (partes da mesma base) e devolve as posições distintas.
local function getAllBasePositions()
    local out = {}
    local function add(pos)
        if not pos then return end
        for _, q in ipairs(out) do
            if (q - pos).Magnitude < 40 then return end
        end
        table.insert(out, pos)
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") then
            local n = obj.Name:lower()
            if n:find("base") or n:find("plot") then
                local ok, piv = pcall(function() return obj:GetPivot().Position end)
                if ok and piv then add(piv) end
            end
        end
        if obj:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
            add(obj.Position)
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- IDENTIFICAÇÃO PELO DONO / PLACA (o certo, não depende de onde você está):
-- No jogo a sua base tem a placa "YOUR BASE" e a do inimigo tem a placa
-- com o nome dele, tipo "phg's Base" (dá pra ver no print: "phg's B...").
-- Isso é definitivo: não importa se você está na base dele na hora de
-- executar, a placa diz de quem é cada base. Por isso essa função é
-- tentada PRIMEIRO, antes de qualquer proximidade.
local function getPosFromObject(obj)
    local cur = obj
    while cur do
        if cur:IsA("Model") then
            local ok, piv = pcall(function() return cur:GetPivot().Position end)
            if ok and piv then return piv end
            return nil
        end
        if cur:IsA("BasePart") then return cur.Position end
        cur = cur.Parent
    end
    return nil
end
local function findBaseByOwner(plr)
    local dn = (plr.DisplayName or ""):lower()
    local nm = (plr.Name or ""):lower()
    for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        -- Placa de texto: "YOUR BASE" / "phg's Base"
        if desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") then
            local txt = (desc.Text or ""):lower()
            if txt ~= "" then
                if plr == LocalPlayer and txt:find("your base", 1, true) then
                    local pos = getPosFromObject(desc)
                    if pos then return pos end
                end
                if (dn ~= "" and txt:find(dn, 1, true) and (txt:find("base", 1, true) or txt:find("'s", 1, true)))
                    or (nm ~= "" and txt:find(nm, 1, true) and (txt:find("base", 1, true) or txt:find("'s", 1, true))) then
                    local pos = getPosFromObject(desc)
                    if pos then return pos end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Nome do modelo: "phg's Base", "Your Base"
        if desc:IsA("Model") then
            local mn = desc.Name:lower()
            if plr == LocalPlayer and mn:find("your base", 1, true) then
                return desc:GetPivot().Position
            end
            if (dn ~= "" and mn:find(dn, 1, true)) or (nm ~= "" and mn:find(nm, 1, true)) then
                if mn:find("base", 1, true) or mn:find("plot", 1, true) then
                    return desc:GetPivot().Position
                end
            end
            -- Valor Owner dentro do modelo
            local owner = desc:FindFirstChild("Owner")
            if owner then
                if owner:IsA("ObjectValue") and owner.Value == plr then
                    return desc:GetPivot().Position
                end
                if owner:IsA("StringValue") and (owner.Value == plr.Name or owner.Value == plr.DisplayName) then
                    return desc:GetPivot().Position
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Resolve as 2 bases juntas, garantindo separação mínima de 150 studs.
-- Se a detecção falhar ou vier igual, usa o spawn e espelha a base inimiga
-- para o lado oposto (direção você -> inimigo).
local function resolveBases(enemy, myPos, enemyPos)
    -- Método principal (definitivo): placa/dono. Não depende de onde você
    -- está parado na hora de executar, então não inverte se você estiver
    -- na base do inimigo (que foi o bug do print: você estava na base do
    -- phg e ele marcou aquela como sua).
    local myByOwner = findBaseByOwner(LocalPlayer)
    local enemyByOwner = enemy and findBaseByOwner(enemy) or nil
    if myByOwner and enemyByOwner and (myByOwner - enemyByOwner).Magnitude > 60 then
        return myByOwner, enemyByOwner
    end
    if myByOwner and not enemyByOwner then
        local all2 = getAllBasePositions()
        local far, farD = nil, -1
        for _, q in ipairs(all2) do
            local d = (q - myByOwner).Magnitude
            if d > 60 and d > farD then farD = d; far = q end
        end
        if far then return myByOwner, far end
    end
    if enemyByOwner and not myByOwner then
        local all2 = getAllBasePositions()
        local far, farD = nil, -1
        for _, q in ipairs(all2) do
            local d = (q - enemyByOwner).Magnitude
            if d > 60 and d > farD then farD = d; far = q end
        end
        if far then return far, enemyByOwner end
    end
    -- Fallback: proximidade, mas pelo SPAWN (onde você renasce = sua base),
    -- não pela posição atual (que pode ser a base do inimigo).
    local all = getAllBasePositions()
    if #all >= 2 then
        local myRef = spawnPos[LocalPlayer] or myPos
        local enRef = (enemy and spawnPos[enemy]) or enemyPos
        local myBase, myD = nil, 1e9
        for _, q in ipairs(all) do
            local d = (q - myRef).Magnitude
            if d < myD then myD = d; myBase = q end
        end
        local enemyBase, enD = nil, 1e9
        for _, q in ipairs(all) do
            if (q - myBase).Magnitude > 60 then
                local d = enRef and (q - enRef).Magnitude or 1e9
                if d < enD then enD = d; enemyBase = q end
            end
        end
        if not enemyBase then
            -- inimigo longe da base dele: pega a mais longe da minha
            local farD = -1
            for _, q in ipairs(all) do
                local d = (q - myBase).Magnitude
                if d > farD then farD = d; enemyBase = q end
            end
        end
        if myBase and enemyBase then
            return myBase, enemyBase
        end
    end
    -- Fallback: Owner / nome (método antigo)
    local myBase = findBasePos(LocalPlayer, nil)
    local enemyBase = nil
    if enemy then
        enemyBase = findBasePos(enemy, myBase)
    end
    if myBase and not enemyBase and enemy then
        if spawnPos[enemy] and (spawnPos[enemy] - myBase).Magnitude > 100 then
            enemyBase = spawnPos[enemy]
        end
    end
    if not myBase then myBase = spawnPos[LocalPlayer] or myPos end
    if not enemyBase then
        -- espelha: inimigo fica do lado oposto ao seu, a 220 studs
        local dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
        if enemyPos then
            local d = enemyPos - myPos
            if d.Magnitude > 10 then dir = d.Unit end
        elseif spawnPos[enemy] then
            local d = spawnPos[enemy] - myBase
            if d.Magnitude > 10 then dir = d.Unit end
        end
        enemyBase = myBase + Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z) * 220
    end
    -- Trava final: se ainda estiverem perto demais, empurra a inimiga pra longe
    local dist = (myBase - enemyBase).Magnitude
    if dist < 150 then
        local dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
        if enemyPos then
            local d = enemyPos - myPos
            if d.Magnitude > 10 then dir = d.Unit end
        end
        enemyBase = myBase + Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z) * 220
    end
    return myBase, enemyBase
end
local function getEnemy()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then return p end
    end
    return nil
end
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    -- Não grava a posição atual como spawn na carga: você pode estar em
    -- qualquer lugar (até na base do inimigo). Só o renascimento vale.
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5) recordSpawn(p) end)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5) recordSpawn(p) end)
end)

local function worldToRadar(worldPos, center, arenaSize)
    local size = Radar.AbsoluteSize.X
    if size < 10 then size = 340 end
    local rx = (worldPos.X - center.X) / arenaSize
    local rz = (worldPos.Z - center.Z) / arenaSize
    local x = size / 2 + rx * size
    local y = size / 2 + rz * size
    x = math.clamp(x, 10, size - 10)
    y = math.clamp(y, 10, size - 10)
    return UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
end
local function placeBox(box, worldPos, center, arenaSize)
    local p = worldToRadar(worldPos, center, arenaSize)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset - 64, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset - 23)
end
local function placeDot(dot, worldPos, center, arenaSize)
    local p = worldToRadar(worldPos, center, arenaSize)
    dot.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset - 8, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset - 8)
end

-- ============ LOOP EM TEMPO REAL ============
local lastFpsUpdate = 0
local fps = 60
local frames = 0
local fpsTime = tick()

radarRenderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not _G.MakimaRadarDuelsActive then return end
    if not Main.Visible then return end
    frames = frames + 1
    if tick() - fpsTime >= 0.5 then
        fps = math.floor(frames / (tick() - fpsTime) + 0.5)
        frames = 0
        fpsTime = tick()
    end
    local myHRP = getHRP(LocalPlayer)
    if not myHRP then return end
    local myPos = myHRP.Position
    local enemy = getEnemy()
    local enemyHRP = enemy and getHRP(enemy)
    local enemyPos = enemyHRP and enemyHRP.Position or nil

    -- CENTRO TRAVADO: as bases não se movem no jogo, então o centro e o
    -- tamanho do radar também não podem mudar a cada segundo. Detecta 1 vez
    -- quando o duelo começa e congela. Só re-detecta se trocar o inimigo
    -- (novo duelo) ou se você mudar a Detecção na engrenagem.
    -- As caixas SUA BASE / INIMIGA NEM APARECEM aqui: a posição delas foi
    -- definida uma vez na criação e nunca é tocada no loop.
    local enemyName = enemy and enemy.Name or nil
    if lockedEnemyName ~= enemyName then
        lockedEnemyName = enemyName
        lockedCenter, lockedArenaSize = nil, nil
        lockedMyBoxPos, lockedEnemyBoxPos = nil, nil
        lockedMyBaseWorld, lockedEnemyBaseWorld = nil, nil
        lockedMyBase, lockedEnemyBase = nil, nil
        cachedMyBase, cachedEnemyBase = nil, nil
    end
    if not lockedCenter then
        local mb, eb = resolveBases(enemy, myPos, enemyPos)
        if not mb then mb = myPos end
        if not eb then eb = myPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 220) end
        lockedMyBaseWorld, lockedEnemyBaseWorld = mb, eb
        lockedCenter = (mb + eb) / 2
        local distBases = (mb - eb).Magnitude
        lockedArenaSize = math.clamp(math.max(distBases * 1.35 + 90, 260), 260, 650)
        -- Trava as caixas NA POSIÇÃO REAL DO MUNDO, uma vez só:
        -- se a sua base é embaixo no mundo, ela fica embaixo no radar,
        -- se é em cima, fica em cima. Depois disso nunca mais muda.
        local function boxPos(worldPos)
            local pr = worldToRadar(worldPos, lockedCenter, lockedArenaSize)
            return UDim2.new(0, pr.X.Offset - 56, 0, pr.Y.Offset - 20)
        end
        lockedMyBoxPos = boxPos(mb)
        lockedEnemyBoxPos = boxPos(eb)
        myBaseBox.Position = lockedMyBoxPos
        enemyBaseBox.Position = lockedEnemyBoxPos
    end
    local center = lockedCenter
    local arenaSize = lockedArenaSize / ZOOM
    -- Auto-correção: a cada 5s tenta de novo pela placa/dono. Se achar bases
    -- diferentes das travadas (ex: o 1º lock foi pelo fallback e a placa
    -- carregou depois), corrige o centro e as caixas sozinho.
    if not manualSwap and tick() - lastOwnerCheck > 5 then
        lastOwnerCheck = tick()
        local mbO = findBaseByOwner(LocalPlayer)
        local ebO = enemy and findBaseByOwner(enemy) or nil
        if mbO and ebO and (mbO - ebO).Magnitude > 60 then
            local changed = true
            if lockedMyBaseWorld and lockedEnemyBaseWorld then
                changed = (mbO - lockedMyBaseWorld).Magnitude > 60 or (ebO - lockedEnemyBaseWorld).Magnitude > 60
            end
            if changed then
                lockedMyBaseWorld, lockedEnemyBaseWorld = mbO, ebO
                lockedCenter = (mbO + ebO) / 2
                local dB = (mbO - ebO).Magnitude
                lockedArenaSize = math.clamp(math.max(dB * 1.35 + 90, 260), 260, 650)
                center = lockedCenter
                arenaSize = lockedArenaSize / ZOOM
                local function boxPos2(worldPos)
                    local pr = worldToRadar(worldPos, lockedCenter, lockedArenaSize)
                    return UDim2.new(0, pr.X.Offset - 56, 0, pr.Y.Offset - 20)
                end
                lockedMyBoxPos = boxPos2(mbO)
                lockedEnemyBoxPos = boxPos2(ebO)
                myBaseBox.Position = lockedMyBoxPos
                enemyBaseBox.Position = lockedEnemyBoxPos
            end
        end
    end
    placeDot(myDot, myPos, center, arenaSize)
    myDot.NameLabel.Visible = SHOW_NAMES
    myDot.NameLabel.Text = "VOCÊ"

    radiusCircle.Visible = SHOW_RADIUS_CIRCLE and SHOW_RADAR
    if SHOW_RADIUS_CIRCLE and SHOW_RADAR then
        local rs = Radar.AbsoluteSize.X
        if rs < 10 then rs = 340 end
        local d = (ALERT_RADIUS / arenaSize) * rs * 2
        radiusCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, d, 0, d)
        radiusCircle.Position = myDot.Position + UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
        radiusCircle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    end

    if enemy and enemyPos then
        enemyDot.Visible = true
        placeDot(enemyDot, enemyPos, center, arenaSize)
        enemyDot.NameLabel.Visible = SHOW_NAMES
        enemyDot.NameLabel.Text = enemy.DisplayName ~= "" and enemy.DisplayName or enemy.Name
        local dist = (myPos - enemyPos).Magnitude
        local distInt = math.floor(dist + 0.5)
        if dist <= ALERT_RADIUS then
            statusLabel.Text = "⚠ INIMIGO PERTO! " .. distInt .. " studs"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 80, 80)
            statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 80, 80)
            distLabel.Text = enemy.Name .. " está na sua base / perto de você!"
        elseif dist <= NEAR_RADIUS then
            statusLabel.Text = "Inimigo próximo - " .. distInt .. " studs"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            distLabel.Text = "Distância até " .. enemy.Name .. ": " .. distInt .. " studs"
        else
            statusLabel.Text = "Sem inimigos próximos"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 225)
            statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(147, 197, 253)
            distLabel.Text = "Distância até " .. enemy.Name .. ": " .. distInt .. " studs  •  Base inimiga no radar"
        end
    else
        enemyDot.Visible = false
        statusLabel.Text = "Sem inimigos na partida"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 225)
        statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(147, 197, 253)
        distLabel.Text = "Entre num Duel pra aparecer o inimigo aqui"
    end

    if tick() - lastFpsUpdate > 0.5 then
        lastFpsUpdate = tick()
        local ping = 0
        pcall(function()
            ping = math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() + 0.5)
        end)
        infoLabel.Text = "FPS: " .. fps .. "    PING: " .. ping .. "ms"
    end
end)

local RADAR_DUELS_ENABLED = false
pcall(function()
    if isfile and readfile and isfile("makima_radar_duels_enabled.txt") then
        local saved = tostring(readfile("makima_radar_duels_enabled.txt") or ""):lower()
        RADAR_DUELS_ENABLED = (saved == "true" or saved == "1" or saved == "on")
    end
end)

local function setRadarDuelsEnabled(on)
    RADAR_DUELS_ENABLED = (on == true)
    pcall(function()
        if type(writefile) == "function" then
            writefile("makima_radar_duels_enabled.txt", RADAR_DUELS_ENABLED and "true" or "false")
        end
    end)

    if RADAR_DUELS_ENABLED then
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            if _G.MakimaRadarDuelsStop then pcall(_G.MakimaRadarDuelsStop) end
            if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
                error("loadstring não está disponível neste executor")
            end
            local fn, compileErr = loadstring(RADAR_DUELS_SOURCE)
            if not fn then error(compileErr or "não foi possível carregar o Radar Duels") end
            fn()
        end)
        if not ok then
            RADAR_DUELS_ENABLED = false
            pcall(function()
                if type(writefile) == "function" then writefile("makima_radar_duels_enabled.txt", "false") end
            end)
            warn("[Makima Hub] Falha ao iniciar Radar Duels: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    else
        pcall(function()
            if _G.MakimaRadarDuelsStop then
                _G.MakimaRadarDuelsStop()
            else
                local uiParent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
                for _, name in ipairs({"RadarExeGui", "RadarExeToggle"}) do
                    local obj = uiParent:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if obj then obj:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

local function aliveParts(pl)

-- ESP BOX ------------------------------------------------
local box = {frames = {}}
function box.stop()
if box.conn then box.conn:Disconnect(); box.conn = nil end
if box.sg then pcall(function() box.sg:Destroy() end); box.sg = nil end
box.frames = {}
end
function box.start()
if box.conn then return end
box.sg = newGui("BH_ESPBox")
box.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
local col = getThemeColor()
for pl, f in pairs(box.frames) do
if pl.Parent ~= Players then pcall(function() f:Destroy() end); box.frames[pl] = nil end
end
for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if pl ~= LP then
local f = box.frames[pl]
local ch, hum, hrp = aliveParts(pl)
local shown = false
if ch then
local head = ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
local top = (head and head.Position or (hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))) + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
local bot = hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
local a = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(top)
local b = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(bot)
if a.Z > 0 and b.Z > 0 then
local h = math.abs(b.Y - a.Y)
local w = h * 0.55
if h > 0 and h == h then
if not f or not f.Parent then
f = Instance.new("Frame", box.sg)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.75
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.ZIndex = 2
local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
st.Thickness = 1.5
st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
box.frames[pl] = f
end
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
local st = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
if st then st.Color = col end
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((a.X + b.X) * 0.5 - w * 0.5, math.min(a.Y, b.Y))
f.Visible = true
shown = true
end
end
end
if f and not shown then f.Visible = false end
end
end
end)
end

-- ESP LINE -----------------------------------------------
local line = {frames = {}}
function line.stop()
if line.conn then line.conn:Disconnect(); line.conn = nil end
if line.sg then pcall(function() line.sg:Destroy() end); line.sg = nil end
line.frames = {}
end
function line.start()
if line.conn then return end
line.sg = newGui("BH_ESPLine")
line.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
local col = getThemeColor()
local vs = cam.ViewportSize
local origin = Vector2.new(vs.X / 2, vs.Y)
local myHrp = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if myHrp then
local p = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(myHrp.Position)
if p.Z > 0 then origin = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) end
end
for pl, f in pairs(line.frames) do
if pl.Parent ~= Players then pcall(function() f:Destroy() end); line.frames[pl] = nil end
end
for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if pl ~= LP then
local f = line.frames[pl]
local ch, hum, hrp = aliveParts(pl)
if ch then
if not f or not f.Parent then
f = Instance.new("Frame", line.sg)
f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.ZIndex = 1
line.frames[pl] = f
end
local p = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
local x, y = p.X, p.Y
if p.Z < 0 then x, y = vs.X - x, vs.Y - y end
local target = Vector2.new(x, y)
local d = target - origin
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((origin.X + target.X) * 0.5, (origin.Y + target.Y) * 0.5)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(d.Magnitude, 1), 2)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.Visible = true
elseif f then
f.Visible = false
end
end
end
end)
end

-- ESP PLAYER (Highlight) -------------------------------------
local hl = {map = {}, conns = {}}
local function hlClear(pl)
local h = hl.map[pl]
if h then pcall(function() h:Destroy() end); hl.map[pl] = nil end
end
local function hlApply(pl)
if pl == LP then return end
hlClear(pl)
local ch = pl.Character
if not ch then return end
local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
h.Name = "BH_ESPPlayer"
h.Adornee = ch
h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
h.FillTransparency = 0.7
h.OutlineTransparency = 0.3
h.FillColor = getThemeColor()
h.OutlineColor = getThemeColor()
h.Parent = ch
hl.map[pl] = h
end
local function hlWatch(pl)
if pl == LP or hl.conns[pl] then return end
hl.conns[pl] = pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
task.wait(0.1)
if hl.on then hlApply(pl) end
end)
hlApply(pl)
end
function hl.start()
hl.on = true
for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hlWatch(pl) end
if hl.add then hl.add:Disconnect() end
if hl.rem then hl.rem:Disconnect() end
hl.add = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hlWatch)
hl.rem = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl)
hlClear(pl)
if hl.conns[pl] then hl.conns[pl]:Disconnect(); hl.conns[pl] = nil end
end)
if hl.color then hl.color:Disconnect() end
local acc = 0
hl.color = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
acc = acc + dt
if acc < 0.5 then return end
acc = 0
local col = getThemeColor()
for _, h in pairs(hl.map) do
if h and h.Parent then h.FillColor = col; h.OutlineColor = col end
end
end)
end
function hl.stop()
hl.on = false
for _, k in ipairs({"add", "rem", "color"}) do
if hl[k] then hl[k]:Disconnect(); hl[k] = nil end
end
for pl, c in pairs(hl.conns) do c:Disconnect() end
hl.conns = {}
for pl in pairs(hl.map) do hlClear(pl) end
end
