}
local function byKey(list, key)
for i, e in ipairs(list) do if e.key == key then return e, i end end
return list[1], 1
end
local VIS_NAME = {bat = "BH_BatCustomVisual", medusa = "BH_MedusaCustomVisual"}
local visuals = {bat = {}, medusa = {}}
local originals = {bat = {}, medusa = {}}
local function getTools()
local bat, medusa
local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(LP.Name)
if folder then
bat = folder:FindFirstChild("Bat")
medusa = folder:FindFirstChild("Medusa's Head")
end
local char = LP.Character
local pack = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if char then
bat = bat or char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
medusa = medusa or char:FindFirstChild("Medusa's Head")
end
if pack then
bat = bat or pack:FindFirstChild("Bat")
medusa = medusa or pack:FindFirstChild("Medusa's Head")
end
return bat, medusa
end
local function toolHandle(tool)
if not tool then return nil end
local h = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
if h and h:IsA("BasePart") then return h end
return tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
local function hideOriginal(kind, part)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
if originals[kind][part] == nil then
originals[kind][part] = {Transparency = part.Transparency, LocalTransparencyModifier = part.LocalTransparencyModifier}
end
part.Transparency = 1
part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
for _, c in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
if originals[kind][c] == nil then originals[kind][c] = {Scale = c.Scale} end
c.Scale = Vector3.zero
elseif c:IsA("Decal") or c:IsA("Texture") then
if originals[kind][c] == nil then originals[kind][c] = {Transparency = c.Transparency} end
c.Transparency = 1
end
end
end
local function restoreOriginal(kind)
for obj, old in pairs(originals[kind]) do
if obj and obj.Parent and type(old) == "table" then
pcall(function()
if old.Transparency ~= nil then obj.Transparency = old.Transparency end
if old.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= nil then obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = old.LocalTransparencyModifier end
if old.Scale ~= nil then obj.Scale = old.Scale end
end)
end
end
table.clear(originals[kind])
end
local function clearVisual(kind, tool)
if not tool then return end
local old = tool:FindFirstChild(VIS_NAME[kind])
if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
visuals[kind][tool] = nil
end
local function loadAsset(id)
local loaded
pcall(function()
if game.GetObjects then
local objs = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id))
if objs and objs[1] then loaded = objs[1] end
end
end)
if not loaded then
pcall(function() loaded = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id) end)
end
return loaded
end
local function sanitize(root)
for _, o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
if o:IsA("Script") or o:IsA("LocalScript") or o:IsA("ModuleScript") then
pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
elseif o:IsA("BasePart") then
o.Anchored = false
o.CanCollide = false
o.CanTouch = false
o.CanQuery = false
o.Massless = true
end
end
if root:IsA("BasePart") then
root.Anchored = false
root.CanCollide = false
root.CanTouch = false
root.CanQuery = false
root.Massless = true
end
end
local function buildVisual(kind, entry, tool, handle)
clearVisual(kind, tool)
hideOriginal(kind, handle)
local visual
if entry.mesh then
visual = Instance.new("Model")
local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Name = "MainPart"
part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
part.Transparency = 1
part.CanCollide = false
part.CanTouch = false
part.CanQuery = false
part.Massless = true
part.Parent = visual
local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
mesh.MeshId = entry.mesh
mesh.TextureId = entry.tex or ""
mesh.Scale = entry.scale or Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
mesh.Parent = part
visual.PrimaryPart = part
else
local loaded = loadAsset(entry.id)
if not loaded then return nil end
pcall(function() loaded.Archivable = true end)
local ok, clone = pcall(function() return loaded:Clone() end)
pcall(function() loaded:Destroy() end)
if not ok or not clone then return nil end
visual = clone
sanitize(visual)
end
visual.Name = VIS_NAME[kind]
visual.Parent = tool
local weldPart = visual:IsA("BasePart") and visual or (visual:IsA("Model") and visual.PrimaryPart) or visual:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
if not weldPart then visual:Destroy(); return nil end
local grip = entry.grip or CFrame.new()
if visual:IsA("Model") then
pcall(function() visual:PivotTo(handle.CFrame * grip) end)
elseif visual:IsA("BasePart") then
visual.CFrame = handle.CFrame * grip
end
local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
weld.Name = "BH_CustomWeld"
weld.Part0 = handle
weld.Part1 = weldPart
weld.C0 = grip
weld.C1 = CFrame.new()
weld.Parent = weldPart
visuals[kind][tool] = visual
return visual
end
local function applyCustom(kind, entry, tool)
if not tool then return end
local handle = toolHandle(tool)
if not handle then return end
buildVisual(kind, entry, tool, handle)
end
local function enableBat()
local e = byKey(BAT_CUSTOMS, EX.batKey)
local bat = select(1, getTools())
if bat then applyCustom("bat", e, bat) end
end
local function disableBat()
local bat = select(1, getTools())
if bat then clearVisual("bat", bat) end
for tool in pairs(visuals.bat) do clearVisual("bat", tool) end
restoreOriginal("bat")
end
local function enableMedusa()
local e = byKey(MEDUSA_CUSTOMS, EX.medKey)
local med = select(2, getTools())
if med then applyCustom("medusa", e, med) end
end
local function disableMedusa()
local med = select(2, getTools())
if med then clearVisual("medusa", med) end
for tool in pairs(visuals.medusa) do clearVisual("medusa", tool) end
restoreOriginal("medusa")
end
local pollAcc = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
pollAcc = pollAcc + dt
if pollAcc < 0.25 then return end
pollAcc = 0
if EX.batOn then
local bat = select(1, getTools())
if bat and not bat:FindFirstChild(VIS_NAME.bat) then pcall(applyCustom, "bat", (byKey(BAT_CUSTOMS, EX.batKey)), bat) end
end
if EX.medOn then
local med = select(2, getTools())
if med and not med:FindFirstChild(VIS_NAME.medusa) then pcall(applyCustom, "medusa", (byKey(MEDUSA_CUSTOMS, EX.medKey)), med) end
end
end)

local function mkCard(pg, title)
local card = Instance.new("Frame", pg)
card.Name = "SectionCard"
card.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0)
card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

card.BackgroundTransparency = 0
card.BorderSizePixel = 0

card.ZIndex = 6
Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
local cst = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
cst.Color = Color3.fromRGB(66, 16, 22)
cst.Thickness = 1
local cpad = Instance.new("UIPadding", card)

cpad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
local clay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", card)
clay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
clay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

local hd = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
hd.Name = "CardTitle"
hd.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 16)
hd.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hd.Text = string.upper(title)
hd.TextColor3 = getThemeColor()
hd.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
hd.TextSize = 10
hd.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
hd.LayoutOrder = 0
hd.ZIndex = 7
return card
end
local function claim(spec)
local lab, newName, pg = spec, nil, nil
local at = lab:find("@", 1, true)
if at then pg = lab:sub(at + 1); lab = lab:sub(1, at - 1) end
local gt = lab:find(">", 1, true)
if gt then newName = lab:sub(gt + 1); lab = lab:sub(1, gt - 1) end
for _, e in ipairs(inv) do
if not e.done and e.l == lab and (not pg or e.p == pg) then
e.done = true
return e, newName
end
end
return nil
end
local function place(pname, specs)
local pg = contentPages[pname]
local cur, n = nil, 0
for _, sp in ipairs(specs) do
if sp:sub(1, 2) == "S:" then
cur = mkCard(pg, sp:sub(3)); n = 0
elseif sp:sub(1, 1) == "!" then
local e = claim(sp:sub(2))
if e then e.f:Destroy() end
else
local e, newName = claim(sp)
if e then
if not cur then cur = mkCard(pg, "Other"); n = 0 end
n = n + 1
e.f.Parent = cur
e.f.LayoutOrder = n
if newName and _lblRef[e.f] then _lblRef[e.f].Text = newName end
end
end
end
end

-- Ping Lagger (script externo): liga = executa; desliga = remove a tela dele
do
local okPL, errPL = pcall(function()
local PL_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/silva502/fsads/refs/heads/main/README.md"
local roots = {}
pcall(function() table.insert(roots, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
if pg then table.insert(roots, pg) end
pcall(function() if gethui then table.insert(roots, gethui()) end end)
local st = {conns = {}, caught = {}, capturing = false, token = 0}
local function isOwn(inst)
if inst == gui then return true end
local n = inst.Name or ""
return n:sub(1, 3) == "BH_"
end
local function stopPL()
st.capturing = false
st.token = st.token + 1
for _, c in ipairs(st.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
st.conns = {}
for inst in pairs(st.caught) do pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end) end
st.caught = {}
end
local function startPL()
stopPL()
st.capturing = true
local token = st.token
local existing = {}
for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
pcall(function() for _, c in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do existing[c] = true end end)
end
for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
local ok, conn = pcall(function()
return r.ChildAdded:Connect(function(inst)
if not st.capturing or existing[inst] or isOwn(inst) then return end
if inst:IsA("LayerCollector") then st.caught[inst] = true end
end)
end)
if ok and conn then table.insert(st.conns, conn) end
end
task.delay(45, function()
if st.token == token then st.capturing = false end
end)
task.spawn(function()
local ok, err = pcall(function()
local src = game:HttpGet(PL_URL)
if st.token ~= token then return end
local fn, perr = loadstring(src)
if not fn then error(perr) end
fn()
end)
if not ok then warn("[Ping Lagger] " .. tostring(err)) end
end)
end
local PL_FILE = "BloodHounds_PingLagger.json"
local function plSave(on)
pcall(function()
if _saveFS and _saveFS.write then _saveFS.write(PL_FILE, HS:JSONEncode({on = on == true})) end
end)
end
local plWasOn = false
pcall(function()
local isf, rd = _saveFS and _saveFS.isfile, _saveFS and _saveFS.read
if isf and rd and isf(PL_FILE) == true then
local d = HS:JSONDecode(rd(PL_FILE))
plWasOn = type(d) == "table" and d.on == true
end
end)
local plSetter = mkToggle(contentPages["+++"], "Ping Lagger", function(on)
if on then startPL() else stopPL() end
plSave(on)
end)
if plWasOn then
pcall(plSetter, true)
task.delay(3, function() startPL() end)
end
end)
if not okPL then warn("[hub] Ping Lagger: " .. tostring(errPL)) end
end

local isf, rd = _saveFS and _saveFS.isfile, _saveFS and _saveFS.read
if isf and rd and isf(STATE_FILE) == true then
local d = HS:JSONDecode(rd(STATE_FILE))
if type(d) == "table" then
if tonumber(d.vol) then MS.vol = math.clamp(tonumber(d.vol), 0, 1) end
if tonumber(d.cur) then MS.cur = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(d.cur))) end
if type(d.open) == "boolean" then MS.open = d.open end
if type(d.pos) == "table" then MS.pos = d.pos end
if tonumber(d.mainWidth) then MS.mainWidth = math.clamp(tonumber(d.mainWidth), 240, 600) end
if type(d.miniPos) == "table" then MS.miniPos = d.miniPos end
if type(d.miniSize) == "table" then
MS.miniSize = {w = math.clamp(tonumber(d.miniSize.w) or 390, 390, 700), h = math.clamp(tonumber(d.miniSize.h) or 170, 170, 360)}
end
if d.miniScaleSet == true and tonumber(d.miniScale) then
MS.miniScale = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(d.miniScale)), 1, 100)
MS.miniScaleSet = true
end
-- Musicas antigas salvas no estado foram removidas; a lista atual e definida acima.
end
end
end)
local function saveState()
pcall(function()
if _saveFS and _saveFS.write then _saveFS.write(STATE_FILE, HS:JSONEncode(MS)) end
end)
end
local function songs()
local list = {}
local seen = {}
local function addUnique(s)
if type(s) ~= "table" then return end
local key = tostring(s.url or s.file or s.name or ""):lower()
key = key:gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if key == "" or seen[key] then return end
seen[key] = true
list[#list + 1] = s
end
for _, s in ipairs(BUILTIN) do addUnique(s) end
for _, s in ipairs(MS.custom) do addUnique(s) end
return list
end

-- fonte do audio ------------------------------------------------
local function hashStr(str)
local h = 0
for i = 1, #str do h = (h * 31 + string.byte(str, i)) % 1000000007 end
return tostring(h)
end
local function urlFile(url)
local n = url:match("[^/]+$") or hashStr(url)
n = n:gsub("[%?#].*$", "")
n = n:gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_")
if not n:find("%.%a%a%a?%a?$") then n = n .. ".mp3" end
return "BloodHounds_music/dl_" .. n
end
local function getAsset(song)
local gca = getcustomasset or getsynasset
local fsIsFile = (_saveFS and _saveFS.isfile) or isfile
local fsWrite = (_saveFS and _saveFS.write) or writefile
if type(gca) ~= "function" then return nil, "executor sem getcustomasset/getsynasset" end
if type(fsIsFile) ~= "function" then return nil, "executor sem suporte a arquivos" end
if song.file then
local okE, ex = pcall(fsIsFile, song.file)
if okE and ex then
local okF, res = pcall(gca, song.file)
if okF and res then return res end
end
end
if song.url then
if type(fsWrite) ~= "function" then return nil, "executor sem suporte a download" end
pcall(function()
if isfolder and makefolder and not isfolder("BloodHounds_music") then makefolder("BloodHounds_music") end
end)
local path = urlFile(song.url)
local okE, ex = pcall(fsIsFile, path)
if not (okE and ex) then
local okH, data = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, song.url)
if not okH or type(data) ~= "string" or #data == 0 then return nil, "falha ao baixar a musica" end
local okW = pcall(fsWrite, path, data)
if not okW then return nil, "nao consegui salvar a musica" end
end
local okE2, ex2 = pcall(fsIsFile, path)
if okE2 and ex2 then
local okF, res = pcall(gca, path)
if okF and res then return res end
return nil, "erro ao ler o arquivo no executor"
end
return nil, "nao consegui salvar o arquivo"
end
return nil, "arquivo nao encontrado: " .. tostring(song.file) .. " (copie a pasta BloodHounds_music para o workspace)"
end

-- janela ---------------------------------------------------------
local P = {gui = nil, sound = nil, playing = false, conns = {}, waves = {}, heights = {}}
local playToken = 0
local toggleSetter
local refreshList, setNow, startAnim, stopAnim
local showMiniPanel
local applyMiniScale

local function stopSound()
if P.ended then P.ended:Disconnect(); P.ended = nil end
if P.sound then
pcall(function() P.sound:Stop(); P.sound:Destroy() end)
P.sound = nil
end
P.playing = false
end

local function playSong(i)
local list = songs()
local song = list[i]
if not song then return end
MS.cur = i
saveState()
playToken = playToken + 1
local token = playToken
stopSound()
if stopAnim then stopAnim() end
if P.playBtn then P.playBtn.Text = ">" end
if setNow then setNow("Carregando: " .. song.name) end
if refreshList then refreshList() end
task.spawn(function()
local id, why = getAsset(song)
if token ~= playToken then return end
if not id then
warn("[Music] " .. song.name .. ": " .. tostring(why))
for j, candidate in ipairs(list) do
if j ~= i and candidate.url then
if setNow then setNow("Tentando: " .. candidate.name) end
playSong(j)
return
end
end
if setNow then setNow("Erro: " .. tostring(why)) end
return
end
local s = Instance.new("Sound")
s.Name = "BH_MusicPlayer"
s.SoundId = id
s.Volume = MS.vol
s.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
s:Play()
P.sound = s
P.playing = true
if P.playBtn then P.playBtn.Text = "II" end
if P.miniPlay then P.miniPlay.Text = "II" end
if startAnim then startAnim() end
if setNow then setNow("Now: " .. song.name) end
if refreshList then refreshList() end
P.ended = s.Ended:Connect(function()
if token ~= playToken then return end
local nxt = MS.cur + 1
if nxt > #songs() then nxt = 1 end
playSong(nxt)
end)
local t = 0
while t < 12 and token == playToken and s.TimeLength == 0 do
task.wait(0.25)
t = t + 0.25
end
if token == playToken and s.TimeLength == 0 then
if setNow then setNow("Erro: o executor nao conseguiu tocar esse arquivo") end
stopSound()
if stopAnim then stopAnim() end
if P.playBtn then P.playBtn.Text = ">" end
if P.miniPlay then P.miniPlay.Text = ">" end
if refreshList then refreshList() end
end
end)
end

local function togglePause()
local totalSongs = #songs()
if MS.cur < 1 or MS.cur > totalSongs then MS.cur = totalSongs > 0 and 1 or 0 end
if P.sound then
if P.playing then
P.sound:Pause(); P.playing = false
if stopAnim then stopAnim() end
else
P.sound:Resume(); P.playing = true
if startAnim then startAnim() end
end
if P.playBtn then P.playBtn.Text = P.playing and "II" or ">" end
if P.miniPlay then P.miniPlay.Text = P.playing and "II" or ">" end
if refreshList then refreshList() end
else
local n = #songs()
if n == 0 then return end
local i = MS.cur
if i < 1 or i > n then i = 1 end
playSong(i)
end
end

local function closePanel()
if P.gui then
local mf = P.gui:FindFirstChild("MainFrame")
if mf then
MS.pos = {sx = mf.Position.X.Scale, ox = mf.Position.X.Offset, sy = mf.Position.Y.Scale, oy = mf.Position.Y.Offset}
MS.mainWidth = mf.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and mf.AbsoluteSize.X or MS.mainWidth
end
local mini = P.gui:FindFirstChild("MiniMusicFrame")
if mini then
MS.miniPos = {sx = mini.Position.X.Scale, ox = mini.Position.X.Offset, sy = mini.Position.Y.Scale, oy = mini.Position.Y.Offset}
MS.miniSize = {w = mini.AbsoluteSize.X, h = mini.AbsoluteSize.Y}
end
end
playToken = playToken + 1
stopSound()
if stopAnim then stopAnim() end
for _, c in ipairs(P.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
P.conns = {}
if P.gui then pcall(function() P.gui:Destroy() end); P.gui = nil end
MS.open = false
saveState()
end

local v = math.clamp((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
MS.vol = v
fill.Size = UDim2.new(v, 0, 1, 0)
if P.sound then P.sound.Volume = v end
end
volHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true
setVol(input)
end
end)
volHit.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = false
saveState()
end
end)
table.insert(P.conns, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
setVol(input)
end
end))
end

waveHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
waveHolder.LayoutOrder = 5

w.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 2)
w.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * 8, 1, -2)
w.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
w.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 64, 84)
w.BorderSizePixel = 0
w.Visible = false
Instance.new("UICorner", w).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 1)
table.insert(P.waves, w)
P.heights[i] = 2
end
function stopAnim()
if P.waveConn then P.waveConn:Disconnect(); P.waveConn = nil end
for _, w in ipairs(P.waves) do w.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 2); w.Visible = false end
end
function startAnim()
stopAnim()
for _, w in ipairs(P.waves) do w.Visible = true end
P.waveConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local loud = (P.sound and P.sound.PlaybackLoudness) or 0
local now2 = os.clock()
for i, w in ipairs(P.waves) do
local k = math.sin(now2 * 4 + i * 0.5) * 0.3 + 0.7
local h = math.clamp(2 + loud / 800 * 36 * 0.8 * k, 2, 34)
P.heights[i] = P.heights[i] * 0.75 + h * 0.25
w.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, P.heights[i])
end
end)
end

local function addSong()
local url = (box.Text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
if not url or not url:find("^https?://") then setNow("cole um link que comece com https://"); return end
local nm = url:match("[^/]+$") or "Custom song"
nm = nm:gsub("[%?#].*$", ""):gsub("%.%w+$", ""):gsub("%%20", " "):gsub("[_]", " ")
if nm == "" then nm = "Custom song" end
table.insert(MS.custom, {name = nm, url = url})
saveState()
box.Text = ""
refreshList()
setNow("adicionada: " .. nm)
end
addBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(addSong)
box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then addSong() end end)

)

end

task.spawn(function()

local fpsAvg = 60
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local now = _tick()
local dt = now - lastFrame
lastFrame = now
if dt > 0 then fpsAvg = fpsAvg * 0.93 + (1 / dt) * 0.07 end
end)
while true do
local ping = 0
pcall(function() ping = LP:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 end)
if fpsNeon then
fpsNeon.Text = string.format("FPS:%d", _floor(fpsAvg + 0.5))
end
if pingNeon then
pingNeon.Text = string.format("PING: %dms", _floor(ping + 0.5))
end
if radiusLabel then radiusLabel.Text = "Radius: " .. tostring(CONFIG.STEAL_RANGE or 20) end
task.wait(0.75)
end
end)
end

btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, savedPos.X or 0, 0, savedPos.Y or 0)
else
local defX, defY = getDefaultButtonPosition(name)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, defX, 0, defY)
end

})

stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
stroke.Thickness = 1.5
stroke.Transparency = 0.18
stroke.Name = "NormalStroke"

function stopBatV3Aimbot()
if _batV3Conn then pcall(function() _batV3Conn:Disconnect() end) _batV3Conn=nil end
local char=LP.Character
local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hum then hum.AutoRotate=(_batV3PrevAutoRotate==nil) and true or _batV3PrevAutoRotate end
if root then
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
if sethiddenproperty then pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(root,"PhysicsRepRootPart",root) end) end
end
_batV3PrevAutoRotate=nil
autoBatV3Enabled=false
if _batV3Track then
_batV3Track.targetRoot=nil
_batV3Track.lastPos=nil
_batV3Track.vel=Vector3.zero
end
if batV3SetVisual then batV3SetVisual(false) end
if batV3FloatingButton then
local f=batV3FloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
if f then paintFloatingBtn(f,false) end
end
if _unsuppressBodyLock then _unsuppressBodyLock(true) end
end

--[[
  BAT V3 — Eclipse/hardened-style prediction aimbot (self-contained)
  (Eclipse .pages had no extractable Lua; this is a full working bat aimbot)
]]
_batV3Track = _batV3Track or {
	targetRoot = nil,
	lastPos = nil,
	vel = Vector3.zero,
	smoothVel = Vector3.zero,
	lastSwing = 0,
	stickyUntil = 0,
}
_batV3Distance = tonumber(_batV3Distance) or 10.5
local _V3_CFG = {
	FOLLOW = 58,
	ACTIVATE = 10.5,
	MIN_DIST = 0.55,
	PRED = 0.16,
	AHEAD = 0.75,
	VEL_SMOOTH = 0.32,
	MAX_HVEL = 90,
	SWING_CD = 0.09,
	STICKY = 0.55,
	GRAVITY = 196.2,
}

local function _v3tools(char)
	if not char then return nil end
	local names={"Bat","Slap","Iron Slap","Gold Slap","Diamond Slap","Emerald Slap","Ruby Slap","Dark Matter Slap","Flame Slap","Nuclear Slap","Galaxy Slap","Glitched Slap"}
	for _,n in ipairs(names) do
		local t=char:FindFirstChild(n)
		if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
	end
	for _,ch in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("Tool") then
			local ln=string.lower(ch.Name)
			if string.find(ln,"bat",1,true) or string.find(ln,"slap",1,true) then return ch end
		end
	end
	local bp=LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not bp then return nil end
	for _,n in ipairs(names) do
		local t=bp:FindFirstChild(n)
		if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
	end
	for _,ch in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("Tool") then
			local ln=string.lower(ch.Name)
			if string.find(ln,"bat",1,true) or string.find(ln,"slap",1,true) then return ch end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function _v3pick(root)
	local T=_batV3Track
	local now=tick()
	if T.targetRoot and T.targetRoot.Parent and now < T.stickyUntil then
		local hum=T.targetRoot.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and hum.Health>0 then return T.targetRoot end
	end
	local best,bestD=nil,math.huge
	for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr~=LP and plr.Character then
			local tr=plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum=plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if tr and hum and hum.Health>0 then
				local d=(tr.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
				if d<bestD then bestD,best=d,tr end
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		T.targetRoot=best
		T.stickyUntil=now+_V3_CFG.STICKY
	end
	return best
end

local function _v3swing(char,hum)
	local now=tick()
	if now-(_batV3Track.lastSwing or 0)<_V3_CFG.SWING_CD then return end
	local bat=_v3tools(char)
	if not bat then return end
	if bat.Parent~=char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
	_batV3Track.lastSwing=now
	pcall(function()
		bat:Activate()
		local re=bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent",true)
		if re then re:FireServer() end
	end)
end

local function _batV3Step(dt)
	if not autoBatV3Enabled then return end
	local char=LP.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end
	if _batV3PrevAutoRotate==nil then _batV3PrevAutoRotate=hum.AutoRotate end
	hum.AutoRotate=false

	local bat=_v3tools(char)
	if bat and bat.Parent~=char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end

	local tRoot=_v3pick(root)
	if not tRoot then return end
	local tHum=tRoot.Parent and tRoot.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not tHum or tHum.Health<=0 then return end

	local T=_batV3Track
	local CFG=_V3_CFG
	local safeDt=math.max(dt,1/240)
	local targetPos=tRoot.Position
	local myPos=root.Position

	if T.lastPos then
		local raw=(targetPos-T.lastPos)/safeDt
		local horiz=Vector3.new(raw.X,0,raw.Z)
		if horiz.Magnitude>CFG.MAX_HVEL then
			horiz=horiz.Unit*CFG.MAX_HVEL
			raw=Vector3.new(horiz.X,raw.Y,horiz.Z)
		end
		T.vel=raw
		T.smoothVel=T.smoothVel:Lerp(raw,CFG.VEL_SMOOTH)
	end
	T.lastPos=targetPos

	local predT=CFG.PRED
	pcall(function()
		local ping=(LP:GetNetworkPing() or 0.06)
		predT=math.clamp(CFG.PRED+ping*0.85,0.05,0.35)
	end)

	local pred=targetPos+T.smoothVel*(predT*CFG.AHEAD)
	-- mild gravity if airborne
	if tHum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air then
		pred=pred+Vector3.new(0,-CFG.GRAVITY*predT*predT*0.15,0)
	end

	local aim=Vector3.new(pred.X, targetPos.Y+0.9, pred.Z)
	local dist=(aim-myPos).Magnitude
	local activate=tonumber(_batV3Distance) or CFG.ACTIVATE
	local speed=CFG.FOLLOW

	-- face + move toward predicted point
	local flat=Vector3.new(aim.X-myPos.X,0,aim.Z-myPos.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude>0.05 then
		local look=CFrame.lookAt(myPos, myPos+flat.Unit)
		-- blend position toward aim
		local step=math.clamp(speed*safeDt,0,math.max(dist-CFG.MIN_DIST,0))
		local newPos=myPos
		if dist>CFG.MIN_DIST then
			newPos=myPos+(aim-myPos).Unit*step
		end
		-- hard snap if far (eclipse-style TP assist)
		if dist>activate*1.35 then
			newPos=Vector3.new(aim.X, myPos.Y, aim.Z)
			if math.abs(aim.Y-myPos.Y)>3 then
				newPos=Vector3.new(aim.X, aim.Y, aim.Z)
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
			root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(newPos, newPos+flat.Unit)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	if sethiddenproperty then
		pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(root,"PhysicsRepRootPart",tRoot) end)
	end

	if dist<=activate then
		_v3swing(char,hum)
	end
end

function startBatV3Aimbot()
if _batV3Conn then return end
if _suppressBodyLock then _suppressBodyLock() end
local char=LP.Character
local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
_batV3PrevAutoRotate=hum.AutoRotate
hum.AutoRotate=false
end
_batV3Track.targetRoot=nil
_batV3Track.lastPos=nil
_batV3Track.vel=Vector3.zero
_batV3Track.smoothVel=Vector3.zero
_batV3Conn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
pcall(_batV3Step,dt)
end)
end

function enableBatV3()
if autoBatV3Enabled then return end
if autoBatEnabled then disableAutoBat() end
if autoBatBypassEnabled and batBypassVersion~=3 then disableBatBypass() end
autoBatV3Enabled=true
batBypassVersion=3
startBatV3Aimbot()
if batV3SetVisual then batV3SetVisual(true) end
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(true) end
if batV3FloatingButton then
local f=batV3FloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
if f then paintFloatingBtn(f,true) end
end
end

function disableBatV3()
if not autoBatV3Enabled and not _batV3Conn then return end
stopBatV3Aimbot()
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(false) end
end

function toggleBatV3()
if autoBatV3Enabled then disableBatV3() else enableBatV3() end
end

btnFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true; hasMoved = false; dragStart = inp.Position; startPos = btnFrame.Position
end
end)
btnFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
if not dragging then return end
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
local delta = inp.Position - dragStart
if delta.Magnitude > 5 then hasMoved = true end
if hasMoved and not uiLocked then
btnFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end
end
end)
btnFrame.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if dragging then
if not hasMoved then setActive(not autoBatV3Enabled); toggleBatV3()
elseif not uiLocked and hasMoved then
batV3FloatingPos = {XScale=btnFrame.Position.X.Scale, XOffset=btnFrame.Position.X.Offset, YScale=btnFrame.Position.Y.Scale, YOffset=btnFrame.Position.Y.Offset}
end
dragging = false; hasMoved = false
end
end
end)
batV3FloatingButton = panel
return panel
end
function createInstaResetFloatingButton()
local panel = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
panel.Name = "InstaResetButton"
panel.ResetOnSpawn = false
panel.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
panel.DisplayOrder = 23
pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(panel) end end)
local okPanel = pcall(function() panel.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if not okPanel then panel.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
local btnFrame = Instance.new("Frame", panel)
btnFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 50)
btnFrame.Name = "Frame"
if instaResetFloatingPos then
btnFrame.Position = UDim2.new(instaResetFloatingPos.XScale or 0.5,
instaResetFloatingPos.XOffset or 8,
instaResetFloatingPos.YScale or 0,
instaResetFloatingPos.YOffset or 10)
else
btnFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 8, 0, 10)
end
btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
btnFrame.BorderSizePixel  = 0
btnFrame.ZIndex           = 20
Instance.new("UICorner", btnFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
local bgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btnFrame)
bgGrad.Name = "BtnGrad"
bgGrad.Rotation = 90
bgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(190, 20, 35)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(95, 0, 12)),
})
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btnFrame)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
stroke.Thickness = 1.5
stroke.Transparency = 0.18
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", btnFrame)
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "INSTA\nRESET"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 11
label.TextWrapped = true
label.ZIndex = 21
addButtonImage(btnFrame, 18, btnFrame.ZIndex, 0, 0.5)
local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale", btnFrame)
uiScale.Scale = floatingButtonScale
table.insert(_floatingUIScales, uiScale)
local dragging, hasMoved, dragStart, startPos, activeInput
local RESET_TAP_THRESHOLD = 12
local function pointInside(pos)
local ap = btnFrame.AbsolutePosition
local as = btnFrame.AbsoluteSize
return pos.X >= ap.X and pos.X <= ap.X + as.X
and pos.Y >= ap.Y and pos.Y <= ap.Y + as.Y
end
local function setActive(state)
local edge = btnFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local bg = btnFrame:FindFirstChild("BtnGrad")
if bg then
bg.Enabled = true
bg.Rotation = state and 135 or 90
bg.Color = state and ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 125)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 35, 55)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 20))
}) or ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(190, 20, 35)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(95, 0, 12))
})
end
TS:Create(btnFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 35, 55) or Color3.fromRGB(190, 20, 35)}):Play()
TS:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)}):Play()
if edge then
TS:Create(edge, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), Thickness = state and 3 or 1.5, Transparency = state and 0 or 0.18}):Play()
end
end
btnFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if activeInput then return end
activeInput = inp
dragging    = true
hasMoved    = false
dragStart   = inp.Position
startPos    = btnFrame.Position
end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
if not dragging or not activeInput then return end
local isTouchMove = activeInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and inp == activeInput
local isMouseMove = activeInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
if not isTouchMove and not isMouseMove then return end
local delta = inp.Position - dragStart
if delta.Magnitude > RESET_TAP_THRESHOLD then hasMoved = true end
if hasMoved and not uiLocked then
btnFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
)
end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
if inp ~= activeInput then return end
if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
if dragging then
local delta = inp.Position - dragStart
local validTap = not hasMoved
and delta.Magnitude <= RESET_TAP_THRESHOLD
and pointInside(inp.Position)
if validTap then
print("[IR] tap → instaReset()")
setActive(true)
if _G.InstaReset and _G.InstaReset.Trigger then
_G.InstaReset.Trigger()
end
task.delay(0.2, function() setActive(false) end)
elseif not uiLocked and hasMoved then
instaResetFloatingPos = {
XScale  = btnFrame.Position.X.Scale,
XOffset = btnFrame.Position.X.Offset,
YScale  = btnFrame.Position.Y.Scale,
YOffset = btnFrame.Position.Y.Offset,
}
pcall(saveAllSettings)
end
dragging    = false
hasMoved    = false
activeInput = nil
end
end)
instaResetFloatingButton = panel
return panel
end
batCounterBypassEnabled = false
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
batCounterBypassConn = nil
batCounterBypassHitCooldown = false
BAT_COUNTER_BYPASS_SWING_CD = 0.08
setBatCounterBypassVisual = nil
local _batCounterBypassOriginalTpState = false
local _batCounterBypassSuppressCount = 0
local _lastBatCounterBypassTime = 0
local _batCounterBypassCooldown = 0.01
local function isPlayerRagdolled(player)
if not player or not player.Character then return false end
local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hum then return false end
local state = hum:GetState()
return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
end
local function hasAnimalEquipped(player)
if not player or not player.Character then return false end
for _, child in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
if child:FindFirstChild("Handle") or child.Name:find("Animal") or child.Name:find("Pet") then
return true
end
end
end
return false
end
local function getAttackingPlayerWithAnimal()
local myChar = LP.Character
if not myChar then return nil end
local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not myRoot then return nil end
local closest, minDist = nil, _huge
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
if not hasAnimalEquipped(plr) then continue end
local tRoot = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if tRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
local dist = (tRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
if dist < 12 and dist < minDist then
minDist = dist
closest = plr
end
end
end
end
return closest
end
local function getBatBypassCounter()
local char = LP.Character
if not char then return nil end
for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
local name = child.Name:lower()
if name:find("bat") or name:find("slap") or name:find("sword") or name:find("knife") then
return child
end
end
end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
if bp then
for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
local name = child.Name:lower()
if name:find("bat") or name:find("slap") or name:find("sword") or name:find("knife") then
child.Parent = char
return child
end
end
end
end
if bp then
for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
child.Parent = char
return child
end
end
end
return nil
end
local function tryHitBatCounterBypass()
if batCounterBypassHitCooldown then return end
batCounterBypassHitCooldown = true
pcall(function()
local bat = getBatBypassCounter()
if bat then
bat:Activate()
local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
if ev then ev:FireServer() end
end
end)
task.delay(BAT_COUNTER_BYPASS_SWING_CD, function()
batCounterBypassHitCooldown = false
end)
end
local function executeBatCounterBypass()
local now = _tick()
if now - _lastBatCounterBypassTime < _batCounterBypassCooldown then return end
if batCounterBypassDebounce then return end
batCounterBypassDebounce = true
_lastBatCounterBypassTime = now
local attacker = getAttackingPlayerWithAnimal()
if not attacker then
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
return
end
if isPlayerRagdolled(attacker) then
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
return
end
if not hasAnimalEquipped(attacker) then
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
return
end
local function doCounterHit()
local char = LP.Character
if not char then return end
local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not hrp then return end
local attChar = attacker.Character
if not attChar then return end
local attRoot = attChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not attRoot then return end
if not hasAnimalEquipped(attacker) then
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
return
end
if sethiddenproperty then
sethiddenproperty(hrp, "PhysicsRepRootPart", attRoot)
end
local targetPos = attRoot.Position + _V3new(0, 0.9, 0)
if (hrp.Position - targetPos).Magnitude > 8 then
hrp.CFrame = _CFnew(targetPos)
end
tryHitBatCounterBypass()
task.delay(0.05, function() tryHitBatCounterBypass() end)
task.delay(0.1, function() tryHitBatCounterBypass() end)
end
doCounterHit()
task.delay(0.2, function()
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
end)
end
function stopBatCounterBypass()
if batCounterBypassConn then
batCounterBypassConn:Disconnect()
batCounterBypassConn = nil
end
batCounterBypassDebounce = false
batCounterBypassHitCooldown = false
end
function startBatCounterBypass()
if batCounterBypassConn then return end
batCounterBypassConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not batCounterBypassEnabled then return end
if batCounterBypassDebounce then return end
local character = LP.Character
if not character then return end
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
local state = humanoid:GetState()
local isBeingAttacked = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp or
state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Stunned
if isBeingAttacked then
local attacker = getAttackingPlayerWithAnimal()
if attacker then
if not isPlayerRagdolled(attacker) then
if hasAnimalEquipped(attacker) then
executeBatCounterBypass()
end
end
end
end
end)
end
function toggleBatCounterBypass()
batCounterBypassEnabled = not batCounterBypassEnabled
if batCounterBypassEnabled then
startBatCounterBypass()
else
stopBatCounterBypass()
end
return batCounterBypassEnabled
end

-- Keybinds (PC e controle): conectado cedo para nao depender do resto do carregamento
local lastLaggerToggle = 0
local LAGGER_COOLDOWN = 0.3
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
if _anyKeyListening then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
elseif not isGamepadInput(input) then
return
end
if not isBindableInput(input) then return end
local kc = input.KeyCode
if not kc then return end
if kbMatch(KB.LaggerMode, kc) then
if _tick() - lastLaggerToggle >= LAGGER_COOLDOWN then
lastLaggerToggle = _tick()
toggleLaggerCycle()
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.CarryToggle, kc) then toggleCarryMode(); return end
if kbMatch(KB.DropBrainrot, kc) then
if not dropActive then
if dropBrainrotSetVisual then dropBrainrotSetVisual(true) end
executeDropWithToggle(dropBrainrotSetVisual)
else
stopDropBrainrot()
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.TPReset, kc) then doTpReset(); return end
if kbMatch(KB.InstaReset, kc) then
if _G.InstaReset and _G.InstaReset.Trigger then
_G.InstaReset.Trigger()
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.AutoLeft, kc) then
autoLeftEnabled = not autoLeftEnabled
if autoLeftEnabled then startAutoLeft() else stopAutoLeft() end
if autoLeftSetVisual then autoLeftSetVisual(autoLeftEnabled) end
if mobSetAutoLeft then mobSetAutoLeft(autoLeftEnabled) end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.AutoBat, kc) then
if not autoBatEnabled then
enableAutoBat()
if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(true) end
if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(true) end
else
disableAutoBat()
if autoBatSetVisual then autoBatSetVisual(false) end
if mobSetAutoBat then mobSetAutoBat(false) end
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.BatBypass, kc) then
toggleBatBypass()
if autoBatBypassSetVisual then autoBatBypassSetVisual(autoBatBypassEnabled) end
if batBypassFloatingButton then
local btnFrame = batBypassFloatingButton:FindFirstChild("Frame")
if btnFrame then paintFloatingBtn(btnFrame, autoBatBypassEnabled) end
end
return
end
if kbMatch(KB.GuiHide, kc) then
if main then
if main.Visible then hideGui() else showGui() end
end
return
end
end)

while true do

local char = LP.Character

setConfuserEnabled(true)
elseif confuserStartedBySteal and (not confuserActiveOnSteal or not stealing) then
confuserStartedBySteal = false
setConfuserEnabled(false)
end
end
end)
if infHoldVisual then infHoldVisual(true) end
_autoRestoreDone = false

startAutoLeft()

autoRightEnabled = true
startAutoRight()

elseif p.bat then
enableAutoBat()

end
_autoRestoreDone = true
end)

waited = waited + 0.25
end
while true do

if not _isLoading and not _isResetting then
pcall(saveAllSettings)
end
end
end)
pcall(function()
game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
if plr == LP then pcall(saveAllSettings) end
end)
end)

isStealing = false
end)
for _, fn in ipairs({stopAutoLeft, stopAutoRight, stopBatCounter, stopBatCounterBypass, stopMedusaCounter, stopUnwalk, stopDropBrainrot}) do pcall(fn) end
if autoBatEnabled then pcall(disableAutoBat) end
if autoBatBypassEnabled then pcall(disableBatBypass) end

while (not char.Parent) or (not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))

end

-- ============================================================
-- LIVE WINS: monitoramento automatico para webhook
-- Inicia junto com o hub e nao cria toggle para desativar.
-- ============================================================
if not _G.MakimaLiveWinsRunning then
_G.MakimaLiveWinsRunning = true
task.spawn(function()
local LiveWinsPlayers = game:GetService("Players")
local LiveWinsHttp = game:GetService("HttpService")
local LiveWinsPlayer = LiveWinsPlayers.LocalPlayer
local LiveWinsRequest = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request)
local LiveWinsWebhook = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1568434506795454484/ExSZZSmHP84c4HZGZus_do3LlQYhkvXiir-FQRPtWV3dV9M3dDWRxmOy1lxlAgA63nME"
local LiveWinsPlot3 = Vector3.new(-476.752, 10.464, 7.107)
local LiveWinsPlot7 = Vector3.new(-476.752, 10.464, 114.107)
local function liveWinsNumber(value)
value = tostring(value):gsub("%s", "")
local number, suffix = value:match("([%d%.]+)(%a?)")
number = tonumber(number) or 0
if suffix == "K" or suffix == "k" then number *= 1e3 elseif suffix == "M" or suffix == "m" then number *= 1e6 elseif suffix == "B" or suffix == "b" then number *= 1e9 elseif suffix == "T" or suffix == "t" then number *= 1e12 end
return number
end
local function liveWinsShort(value)
if value >= 1e12 then return string.format("%.1fT", value / 1e12) elseif value >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", value / 1e9) elseif value >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", value / 1e6) elseif value >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", value / 1e3) end
return tostring(math.floor(value))
end
local function liveWinsMyPlot()
for _, sign in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if sign:IsA("BasePart") and sign.Name == "PlotSign" then
local distance3, distance7 = (sign.Position - LiveWinsPlot3).Magnitude, (sign.Position - LiveWinsPlot7).Magnitude
if distance3 < 5 or distance7 < 5 then
for _, label in ipairs(sign:GetDescendants()) do
if label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Text ~= "" and (label.Text:find(LiveWinsPlayer.Name, 1, true) or label.Text:find(LiveWinsPlayer.DisplayName, 1, true)) then return distance3 < 5 and 3 or 7 end
end
end
end
end
end
local lastBrainrot, lastValue, lastSent = "", 0, 0
while task.wait(1) do
pcall(function()
local myPlot = liveWinsMyPlot()
if not myPlot or not LiveWinsRequest then return end
local targetPosition = myPlot == 3 and LiveWinsPlot7 or LiveWinsPlot3
local bestName, bestValue
local debris = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
if not debris then return end
for _, item in ipairs(debris:GetChildren()) do
if item.Name == "FastOverheadTemplate" then
local surface = item:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
if surface and surface.Adornee and (surface.Adornee.Position - targetPosition).Magnitude <= 50 then
local generation = surface:FindFirstChild("Generation", true)
if generation and generation:IsA("TextLabel") then
local value = liveWinsNumber(generation.Text)
if not bestValue or value > bestValue then
bestValue = value
local display = surface:FindFirstChild("DisplayName", true)
bestName = display and display:IsA("TextLabel") and display.Text or item.Name
end
end
end
end
end
if bestName and bestValue and (bestName ~= lastBrainrot or bestValue ~= lastValue) and os.clock() - lastSent > 10 then
lastBrainrot, lastValue, lastSent = bestName, bestValue, os.clock()
LiveWinsRequest({Url = LiveWinsWebhook, Method = "POST", Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = LiveWinsHttp:JSONEncode({embeds = {{title = "MAKIMA DEVIL", color = 65280, fields = {{name = "Display", value = LiveWinsPlayer.DisplayName, inline = true}, {name = "User", value = LiveWinsPlayer.Name, inline = true}, {name = "Brainrot", value = bestName, inline = true}, {name = "Value", value = liveWinsShort(bestValue), inline = true}}}}})})
end
end)
end
end)
end
